package com.museplay.android

import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.OutputStreamWriter
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URL

class MiniMaxGenerator {
    suspend fun generate(
        title: String,
        prompt: String,
        mode: MusicMode
    ): GeneratedMusic = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val apiKey = BuildConfig.MINIMAX_API_KEY.trim()
        if (apiKey.isBlank()) {
            throw IllegalStateException("MINIMAX_API_KEY is missing. Add it to android/secrets.properties.")
        }

        val endpoint = BuildConfig.MINIMAX_BASE_URL.trimEnd('/') + BuildConfig.MINIMAX_PATH
        val requestBody = JSONObject().apply {
            put("model", BuildConfig.MINIMAX_MODEL)
            put("prompt", prompt)
            put("is_instrumental", mode.isInstrumental)
            put("output_format", "url")
            put(
                "audio_setting",
                JSONObject().apply {
                    put("sample_rate", 44100)
                    put("bitrate", 256000)
                    put("format", "mp3")
                }
            )
        }

        val connection = (URL(endpoint).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
            requestMethod = "POST"
            connectTimeout = 150_000
            readTimeout = 300_000
            doInput = true
            doOutput = true
            setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json")
            setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer $apiKey")
        }

        try {
            OutputStreamWriter(connection.outputStream, Charsets.UTF_8).use { writer ->
                writer.write(requestBody.toString())
            }

            val statusCode = connection.responseCode
            val raw = readText(
            <truncated omitted_approx_tokens="19" />atusCode !in 200..299) {
                throw IllegalStateException("MiniMax request failed ($statusCode): $raw")
            }

            val root = JSONObject(raw)
            val baseResp = root.optJSONObject("base_resp")
            val miniMaxCode = baseResp?.optInt("status_code", -1) ?: -1
            if (miniMaxCode != 0) {
                val message = baseResp?.optString("status_msg").orEmpty().ifBlank { "unknown error" }
                throw IllegalStateException("MiniMax failed: $message")
            }

            val data = root.optJSONObject("data")
                ?: throw IllegalStateException("MiniMax returned no data.")
            val audioUrl = data.optString("audio").trim()
            if (!audioUrl.startsWith("http")) {
                throw IllegalStateException("MiniMax did not return an audio URL.")
            }

            val durationMs = root.optJSONObject("extra_info")
                ?.optLong("music_duration")
                ?.takeIf { it > 0 }

            GeneratedMusic(
                title = title.ifBlank { "Generated Track" },
                summary = buildSummary(mode, durationMs),
                prompt = prompt,
                audioUrl = audioUrl,
                durationMs = durationMs,
                mode = mode,
                model = BuildConfig.MINIMAX_MODEL
            )
        } finally {
            connection.disconnect()
        }
    }

    private fun buildSummary(mode: MusicMode, durationMs: Long?): String {
        val duration = durationMs?.let { "${(it / 1000.0).roundToOne()}s" } ?: "ready"
        return "${mode.label} generated by MiniMax Music 2.6, $duration."
    }

    private fun Double.roundToOne(): String {
        return kotlin.math.round(this * 10.0).div(10.0).toString()
    }

    private fun readText(stream: java.io.InputStream?): String {
        if (stream == null) return ""
        return BufferedReader(stream.reader(Charsets.UTF_8)).use { it.readText() }
    }
}

package com.museplay.android

import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

class FlashPlayViewModel : ViewModel() {
    private val generator = MiniMaxGenerator()

    var selectedTab by mutableStateOf(FlashTab.Home)
        private set

    var feedTracks by mutableStateOf(SampleMusic.feed())
        private set

    var generatedTracks by mutableStateOf(emptyList<MusicTrack>())
        private set

    var favoriteTracks by mutableStateOf(emptyList<MusicTrack>())
        private set

    var trackTitle by mutableStateOf("Happy Morning")
    var musicPrompt by mutableStateOf("A happy 30-second instrumental track, upbeat pop, bright piano, ukulele, hand claps, light drums, joyful and sunny, no vocals.")
    var musicMode by mutableStateOf(MusicMode.Instrumental)
    var isGenerating by mutableStateOf(false)
    var generationError by mutableStateOf<String?>(null)
    var lastGeneratedAudioUrl by mutableStateOf<String?>(null)
        private set
    var pendingPlayTrackId by mutableStateOf<String?>(null)
        private set

    fun switchTab(tab: FlashTab) {
        selectedTab = tab
    }

    fun openTrack(track: MusicTrack) {
        pendingPlayTrackId = track.id
        selectedTab = FlashTab.Home
    }

    fun consumePendingPlayTrackId() {
        pendingPlayTrackId = null
    }

    fun updateTitle(value: String) {
        trackTitle = value
    }

    fun updatePrompt(value: String) {
        musicPrompt = value
    }

    fun updateMode(value: MusicMode) {
        musicMode = value
    }

    fun toggleFavorite(trackId: String) {
        feedTracks = feedTracks.map { track ->
            if (track.id == trackId) track.copy(isFavorite = !track.isFavorite) else track
        }
        generatedTracks = generatedTracks.map { track ->
            if (track.id == trackId) track.copy(isFavorite = !track.isFavorite) else track
        }
        favoriteTracks = (feedTracks + generatedTracks).filter { it.isFavorite }.distinctBy { it.id }
    }

    fun generateMusic() {
        if (isGenerating) return
        val cleanTitle = trackTitle.trim()
        val cleanPrompt = musicPrompt.trim()
        if (cleanTitle.isEmpty() || cleanPrompt.isEmpty()) {
            generationError = "Please enter both the track title and music prompt."
            return
        }

        isGenerating = true
        generationError = null
        lastGeneratedAudioUrl = null

        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                val result = generator.generate(
                    title = cleanTitle,
                    prompt = cleanPrompt,
                    mode = musicMode
                )
                val track = MusicTrack(
                    title = result.title,
                    summary = result.summary,
                    prompt = result.prompt,
                    audioUrl = result.audioUrl,
                    durationMs = result.durationMs,
                    mode = result.mode,
                    palette = FlashPlayPalette.Cards[(generatedTracks.size + 1) % FlashPlayPalette.Cards.size],
                    creator = result.model,
                    isGenerated = true
                )
                lastGeneratedAudioUrl = result.audioUrl
                generatedTracks = listOf(track) + generatedTracks
                feedTracks = listOf(track) + feedTracks
                pendingPlayTrackId = track.id
                selectedTab = FlashTab.Home
            } catch (error: Throwable) {
                generationError = error.message ?: "Failed to generate music."
            } finally {
                isGenerating = false
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.museplay.android

import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.OutputStreamWriter
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URL

class MiniMaxGenerator {
    suspend fun generate(
        title: String,
        prompt: String,
        mode: MusicMode
    ): GeneratedMusic = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val apiKey = BuildConfig.MINIMAX_API_KEY.trim()
        if (apiKey.isBlank()) {
            throw IllegalStateException("MINIMAX_API_KEY is missing. Add it to android/secrets.properties.")
        }

        val endpoint = BuildConfig.MINIMAX_BASE_URL.trimEnd('/') + BuildConfig.MINIMAX_PATH
        val requestBody = JSONObject().apply {
            put("model", BuildConfig.MINIMAX_MODEL)
            put("prompt", prompt)
            put("is_instrumental", mode.isInstrumental)
            put("output_format", "url")
            put(
                "audio_setting",
                JSONObject().apply {
                    put("sample_rate", 44100)
                    put("bitrate", 256000)
                    put("format", "mp3")
                }
            )
        }

        val connection = (URL(endpoint).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
            requestMethod = "POST"
            connectTimeout = 150_000
            readTimeout = 300_000
            doInput = true
            doOutput = true
            setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json")
            setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer $apiKey")
        }

        try {
            OutputStreamWriter(connection.outputStream, Charsets.UTF_8).use { writer ->
                writer.write(requestBody.toString())
            }

            val statusCode = connection.responseCode
            val raw = readText(
            <truncated omitted_approx_tokens="19" />atusCode !in 200..299) {
                throw IllegalStateException("MiniMax request failed ($statusCode): $raw")
            }

            val root = JSONObject(raw)
            val baseResp = root.optJSONObject("base_resp")
            val miniMaxCode = baseResp?.optInt("status_code", -1) ?: -1
            if (miniMaxCode != 0) {
                val message = baseResp?.optString("status_msg").orEmpty().ifBlank { "unknown error" }
                throw IllegalStateException("MiniMax failed: $message")
            }

            val data = root.optJSONObject("data")
                ?: throw IllegalStateException("MiniMax returned no data.")
            val audioUrl = data.optString("audio").trim()
            if (!audioUrl.startsWith("http")) {
                throw IllegalStateException("MiniMax did not return an audio URL.")
            }

            val durationMs = root.optJSONObject("extra_info")
                ?.optLong("music_duration")
                ?.takeIf { it > 0 }

            GeneratedMusic(
                title = title.ifBlank { "Generated Track" },
                summary = buildSummary(mode, durationMs),
                prompt = prompt,
                audioUrl = audioUrl,
                durationMs = durationMs,
                mode = mode,
                model = BuildConfig.MINIMAX_MODEL
            )
        } finally {
            connection.disconnect()
        }
    }

    private fun buildSummary(mode: MusicMode, durationMs: Long?): String {
        val duration = durationMs?.let { "${(it / 1000.0).roundToOne()}s" } ?: "ready"
        return "${mode.label} generated by MiniMax Music 2.6, $duration."
    }

    private fun Double.roundToOne(): String {
        return kotlin.math.round(this * 10.0).div(10.0).toString()
    }

    private fun readText(stream: java.io.InputStream?): String {
        if (stream == null) return ""
        return BufferedReader(stream.reader(Charsets.UTF_8)).use { it.readText() }
    }
}

package com.museplay.android

import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

class FlashPlayViewModel : ViewModel() {
    private val generator = MiniMaxGenerator()

    var selectedTab by mutableStateOf(FlashTab.Home)
        private set

    var feedTracks by mutableStateOf(SampleMusic.feed())
        private set

    var generatedTracks by mutableStateOf(emptyList<MusicTrack>())
        private set

    var favoriteTracks by mutableStateOf(emptyList<MusicTrack>())
        private set

    var trackTitle by mutableStateOf("Happy Morning")
    var musicPrompt by mutableStateOf("A happy 30-second instrumental track, upbeat pop, bright piano, ukulele, hand claps, light drums, joyful and sunny, no vocals.")
    var musicMode by mutableStateOf(MusicMode.Instrumental)
    var isGenerating by mutableStateOf(false)
    var generationError by mutableStateOf<String?>(null)
    var lastGeneratedAudioUrl by mutableStateOf<String?>(null)
        private set
    var pendingPlayTrackId by mutableStateOf<String?>(null)
        private set

    fun switchTab(tab: FlashTab) {
        selectedTab = tab
    }

    fun openTrack(track: MusicTrack) {
        pendingPlayTrackId = track.id
        selectedTab = FlashTab.Home
    }

    fun consumePendingPlayTrackId() {
        pendingPlayTrackId = null
    }

    fun updateTitle(value: String) {
        trackTitle = value
    }

    fun updatePrompt(value: String) {
        musicPrompt = value
    }

    fun updateMode(value: MusicMode) {
        musicMode = value
    }

    fun toggleFavorite(trackId: String) {
        feedTracks = feedTracks.map { track ->
            if (track.id == trackId) track.copy(isFavorite = !track.isFavorite) else track
        }
        generatedTracks = generatedTracks.map { track ->
            if (track.id == trackId) track.copy(isFavorite = !track.isFavorite) else track
        }
        favoriteTracks = (feedTracks + generatedTracks).filter { it.isFavorite }.distinctBy { it.id }
    }

    fun generateMusic() {
        if (isGenerating) return
        val cleanTitle = trackTitle.trim()
        val cleanPrompt = musicPrompt.trim()
        if (cleanTitle.isEmpty() || cleanPrompt.isEmpty()) {
            generationError = "Please enter both the track title and music prompt."
            return
        }

        isGenerating = true
        generationError = null
        lastGeneratedAudioUrl = null

        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                val result = generator.generate(
                    title = cleanTitle,
                    prompt = cleanPrompt,
                    mode = musicMode
                )
                val track = MusicTrack(
                    title = result.title,
                    summary = result.summary,
                    prompt = result.prompt,
                    audioUrl = result.audioUrl,
                    durationMs = result.durationMs,
                    mode = result.mode,
                    palette = FlashPlayPalette.Cards[(generatedTracks.size + 1) % FlashPlayPalette.Cards.size],
                    creator = result.model,
                    isGenerated = true
                )
                lastGeneratedAudioUrl = result.audioUrl
                generatedTracks = listOf(track) + generatedTracks
                feedTracks = listOf(track) + feedTracks
                pendingPlayTrackId = track.id
                selectedTab = FlashTab.Home
            } catch (error: Throwable) {
                generationError = error.message ?: "Failed to generate music."
            } finally {
                isGenerating = false
            }
        }
    }
}

+        }
+    }
+}
+
+@Composable
+private fun PromptStarterRow(onPick: (String, String) -> Unit) {
+    val starters = listOf(
+        "Focus" to "A focused instrumental for deep work, clean electronic pulse, warm bass, soft piano details, steady and modern, no vocals.",
+        "Heal" to "A healing instrumental for a tired heart, slow piano, soft strings, gentle ambient pads, intimate and comforting, no vocals.",
+        "Run" to "A high-energy instrumental for running at night, punchy drums, bright synth hooks, confident bass, cinematic lift, no vocals."
+    )
+    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
+        Text("Quick moods", fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, fontSize = 18.sp, color = FlashPlayPalette.Ink)
+        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
+            starters.forEach { (title, prompt) ->
+                Surface(
+                    modifier = Modifier
+                        .weight(1f)
+                        .clickable { onPick(title, prompt) },
+                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
+                    color = Color.White
+                ) {
+                    Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(12.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
+                        Text(title, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, color = FlashPlayPalette.Ink)
+                        Text("Use", fontSize = 12.sp, color = FlashPlayPalette.Brand, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
*** End Patch

package com.museplay.android

import android.content.Context
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.File
import java.io.OutputStreamWriter
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URL

class MiniMaxGenerator(private val context: Context) {
    suspend fun generate(
        title: String,
        prompt: String,
        mode: MusicMode
    ): GeneratedMusic = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val apiKey = BuildConfig.MINIMAX_API_KEY.trim()
        if (apiKey.isBlank()) {
            throw IllegalStateException("MINIMAX_API_KEY is missing. Add it to android/secrets.properties.")
        }

        val endpoint = BuildConfig.MINIMAX_BASE_URL.trimEnd('/') + BuildConfig.MINIMAX_PATH
        val requestBody = JSONObject().apply {
            put("model", BuildConfig.MINIMAX_MODEL)
            put("prompt", prompt)
            put("is_instrumental", mode.isInstrumental)
            put("output_format", "url")
            put(
                "audio_setting",
                JSONObject().apply {
                    put("sample_rate", 44100)
                    put("bitrate", 256000)
                    put("format", "mp3")
                }
            )
        }

        val connection = (URL(endpoint).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
            requestMethod = "POST"
            connectTimeout = 150_000
            readTimeout = 300_000
            doInput = true
            doOutput = true
            setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json")
            setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer $apiKey")
        }

        try {
            OutputStreamWriter(connection.outputStream, Charsets.UTF_8).use { writer ->
                writer.write(requestBody.toString())
            }

            va<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="307" />erated Track" },
                summary = buildSummary(mode, durationMs),
                prompt = prompt,
                audioUrl = audioUrl,
                localPath = downloadAudio(audioUrl),
                durationMs = durationMs,
                mode = mode,
                model = BuildConfig.MINIMAX_MODEL
            )
        } finally {
            connection.disconnect()
        }
    }

    private fun buildSummary(mode: MusicMode, durationMs: Long?): String {
        val duration = durationMs?.let { "${(it / 1000.0).roundToOne()}s" } ?: "ready"
        return "${mode.label} generated by MiniMax Music 2.6, $duration."
    }

    private fun Double.roundToOne(): String {
        return kotlin.math.round(this * 10.0).div(10.0).toString()
    }

    private fun readText(stream: java.io.InputStream?): String {
        if (stream == null) return ""
        return BufferedReader(stream.reader(Charsets.UTF_8)).use { it.readText() }
    }

    private fun downloadAudio(audioUrl: String): String {
        val musicDir = File(context.filesDir, "generated_music").apply { mkdirs() }
        val output = File(musicDir, "minimax-${System.currentTimeMillis()}.mp3")
        val connection = (URL(audioUrl).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
            requestMethod = "GET"
            connectTimeout = 60_000
            readTimeout = 120_000
            doInput = true
        }
        try {
            val statusCode = connection.responseCode
            if (statusCode !in 200..299) {
                val error = readText(connection.errorStream)
                throw IllegalStateException("Audio download failed ($statusCode): $error")
            }
            connection.inputStream.use { input ->
                output.outputStream().use { fileOut ->
                    input.copyTo(fileOut)
                }
            }
            return output.absolutePath
        } finally {
            connection.disconnect()
        }
    }
}

    ): GeneratedMusic = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val apiKey = BuildConfig.MINIMAX_API_KEY.trim()
        if (apiKey.isBlank()) {
            throw IllegalStateException("MINIMAX_API_KEY is missing. Add it to android/secrets.properties.")
        }

        val endpoint = BuildConfig.MINIMAX_BASE_URL.trimEnd('/') + BuildConfig.MINIMAX_PATH
        val requestBody = JSONObject().apply {
            put("model", BuildConfig.MINIMAX_MODEL)
            put("prompt", prompt)
            put("is_instrumental", mode.isInstrumental)
            put("output_format", "url")
            put(
                "audio_setting",
                JSONObject().apply {
                    put("sample_rate", 44100)
                    put("bitrate", 256000)
                    put("format", "mp3")
                }
            )
        }

        val connection = (URL(endpoint).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
            requestMethod = "POST"
            connectTimeout = 150_000
            readTimeout = 300_000
            doInput = true
            doOutput = true
            setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json")
            setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer $apiKey")
        }

        try {
            OutputStreamWriter(connection.outputStream, Charsets.UTF_8).use { writer ->
                writer.write(requestBody.toString())
            }

            va<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="307" />erated Track" },
                summary = buildSummary(mode, durationMs),
                prompt = prompt,
                audioUrl = audioUrl,
                localPath = downloadAudio(audioUrl),
                durationMs = durationMs,
                mode = mode,
                model = BuildConfig.MINIMAX_MODEL
            )
        } finally {
            connection.disconnect()
        }
    }

    private fun buildSummary(mode: MusicMode, durationMs: Long?): String {
        val duration = durationMs?.let { "${(it / 1000.0).roundToOne()}s" } ?: "ready"
        return "${mode.label} generated by MiniMax Music 2.6, $duration."
    }

    private fun Double.roundToOne(): String {
        return kotlin.math.round(this * 10.0).div(10.0).toString()
    }

    private fun readText(stream: java.io.InputStream?): String {
        if (stream == null) return ""
        return BufferedReader(stream.reader(Charsets.UTF_8)).use { it.readText() }
    }

    private fun downloadAudio(audioUrl: String): String {
        val musicDir = File(context.filesDir, "generated_music").apply { mkdirs() }
        val output = File(musicDir, "minimax-${System.currentTimeMillis()}.mp3")
        val connection = (URL(audioUrl).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
            requestMethod = "GET"
            connectTimeout = 60_000
            readTimeout = 120_000
            doInput = true
        }
        try {
            val statusCode = connection.responseCode
            if (statusCode !in 200..299) {
                val error = readText(connection.errorStream)
                throw IllegalStateException("Audio download failed ($statusCode): $error")
            }
            connection.inputStream.use { input ->
                output.outputStream().use { fileOut ->
                    input.copyTo(fileOut)
                }
            }
            return output.absolutePath
        } finally {
            connection.disconnect()
        }
    }
}

[536] assistant: 已修复 Song 模式无法生成的问题。

原因是 MiniMax 的 `Song` 模式要求必须传 `lyrics`，之前 APK 只传了 `prompt`，所以返回：

```text
lyrics is required
```

我做了这些改动：

- Song 模式下新增 `Lyrics for Song mode` 输入框
- 如果用户没填歌词，会自动生成一段默认歌词兜底
- API 请求在 Song 模式下会传：
  - `is_instrumental: false`
  - `lyrics`
  - `lyrics_optimizer: false`
- Instrumental 模式保持原逻辑，不需要歌词
- 已重新构建并安装到模拟器

我还用同一个 MiniMax key 单独测试了 Song API，请求成功：

```text
status: success
duration: 79.96 秒
audio_type: url
```

@Composable
private fun TrackSection(
    title: String,
    tracks: List<MusicTrack>,
    emptyState: String,
    activeTrackId: String?,
    onOpen: (MusicTrack) -> Unit,
    onPlay: (MusicTrack) -> Unit
) {
    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
        Text(title, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, fontSize = 24.sp, color = FlashPlayPalette.Ink)
        if (tracks.isEmpty()) {
            EmptyState(title = emptyState, body = "Generated tracks are kept in this session.")
        } else {
            tracks.forEach { track ->
                TrackCard(
                    track = track,
                    isPlaying = activeTrackId == track.id,
                    onPlay = { onPlay(track) },
                    onFavorite = { onOpen(track) }
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

```text
lyrics is required

@Composable
private fun TrackSection(
    title: String,
    tracks: List<MusicTrack>,
    emptyState: String,
    activeTrackId: String?,
    onOpen: (MusicTrack) -> Unit,
    onPlay: (MusicTrack) -> Unit
) {
    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
        Text(title, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, fontSize = 24.sp, color = FlashPlayPalette.Ink)
        if (tracks.isEmpty()) {
            EmptyState(title = emptyState, body = "Generated tracks are kept in this session.")
        } else {
            tracks.forEach { track ->
                TrackCard(
                    track = track,
                    isPlaying = activeTrackId == track.id,
                    onPlay = { onPlay(track) },
                    onFavorite = { onOpen(track) }
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

+        for (index in 0 until choices.length()) {

+            val content = message.opt("content")

+                        if (item is JSONObject) append(item.optString("text"))
+                        if (item is String) append(item)
+                    }
+                }.trim()
+                if (text.isNotBlank()) return text
+            }
+        }
+        return ""

@Composable
private fun ListenScreen(
    dailyVibe: String,
    tracks: List<MusicTrack>,
    activeTrackId: String?,
    playbackError: String?,
    onPlay: (MusicTrack) -> Unit,
    onFavorite: (String) -> Unit
) {
    LazyColumn(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.safeDrawing)
            .padding(horizontal = 20.dp),
        contentPadding = PaddingValues(bottom = 112.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)
    ) {
        item {
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))
            Text("MusePlay", fontSize = 36.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, color = FlashPlayPalette.Ink)
            Text(
                "Generate music from language and save it locally.",
                color = FlashPlayPalette.Ink.copy(alpha = 0.62f),
                fontSize = 15.sp,
                lineHeight = 20.sp
            )
            Text(
                "Private by default: generated MP3 files are downloaded into this app only.",
                color = FlashPlayPalette.Brand,
                fontSize = 12.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
            )
        }

        item {
            DailyVibeCard(text = dailyVibe, count = tracks.size)
        }

        playbackError?.let { message ->
            item { NoticeCard(message = message, color = Color(0xFFFFF0F0), ink = Color(0xFFB42318)) }
        }

        if (tracks.isEmpty()) {
            item {
                EmptyState(
                    title = "No music yet",
                    body = "Create a track, then come back here to listen."
                )
            }
        } else {
            items(tracks, key = { it.id }) { track ->
                TrackCard(
                    track = track,
                    isPlaying = activeTrackId == track.id,
                    onPlay = { onPlay(track) },
                    onFavorite = { onFavorite(track.id) }
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

private fun TrackCard(

@Composable
private fun BottomBar(
    selectedTab: FlashTab,
    onSelect: (FlashTab) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    Row(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.navigationBars)

            .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
    ) {
        FlashTab.entries.forEach { tab ->
            val selected = tab == selectedTab
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .weight(1f)
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(18.dp))
                    .background(if (selected) FlashPlayPalette.Brand else Color.Transparent)
                    .clickable { onSelect(tab) }
                    .padding(vertical = 12.dp),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Text(
                    tab.label,
                    color = if (selected) Color.White else FlashPlayPalette.Ink,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontSize = 13.sp
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun BottomBar(
    selectedTab: FlashTab,
    onSelect: (FlashTab) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    Row(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.navigationBars)
            .padding(horizontal = 18.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(24.dp))
            .background(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.96f))
            .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
    ) {
        FlashTab.entries.forEach { tab ->
            val selected = tab == selectedTab
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .weight(1f)
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(18.dp))
                    .background(if (selected) FlashPlayPalette.Brand else Color.Transparent)
                    .clickable { onSelect(tab) }
                    .padding(vertical = 12.dp),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Text(
                    tab.label,
                    color = if (selected) Color.White else FlashPlayPalette.Ink,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontSize = 13.sp
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

+async function fetchWithRetry(url, options = {}, attempts = 3) {
+  let lastError;
+  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= attempts; attempt += 1) {
+    try {
+      return await fetch(url, options);
+    } catch (error) {
+      lastError = error;
+      const delay = 5000 * attempt;
+      console.log(`network retry ${attempt}/${attempts} in ${delay}ms`);
+      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
+    }
+  }
+  throw lastError;
+}

async function requestJsonWithCurl(body, slug, attempts = 3) {
  const payloadPath = path.join(outDir, `${slug}.request.json`);
  const responsePath = path.join(outDir, `${slug}.response.json`);
  await fs.writeFile(payloadPath, JSON.stringify(body));
  await runCurlWithRetry(

      "--request",
      "POST",

      "https://api.minimax.io/v1/music_generation",
      "--header",
      `Authorization: Bearer ${apiKey}`,
      "--header",
      "Content-Type: application/json",
      "--data",
      `@${payloadPath}`,
      "--output",
      responsePath,
    ],
    attempts
  );
  return JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(responsePath, "utf8"));
}

async function downloadWithCurl(url, outputPath, attempts = 3) {
  await runCurlWithRetry(["-L", "--silent", "--show-error", url, "--output", outputPath], attempts);
}

async function runCurlWithRetry(args, attempts = 3) {
  let lastError;
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= attempts; attempt += 1) {
    try {
      return await execFileAsync("curl", args, { maxBuffer: 1024 * 1024 * 4 });
    } catch (error) {
      lastError = error;
      const delay = 5000 * attempt;
      console.log(`curl retry ${attempt}/${attempts} in ${delay}ms`);
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
    }
  }
  throw lastError;
}

#include <CoreAudio/CoreAudio.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
  if (argc != 2) {
    fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s <audio-device-id>\n", argv[0]);
    return 2;
  }

  AudioDeviceID device = (AudioDeviceID)strtoul(argv[1], NULL, 10);
  AudioObjectPropertyAddress address = {
    kAudioHardwarePropertyDefaultOutputDevice,
    kAudioObjectPropertyScopeGlobal,
    kAudioObjectPropertyElementMain
  };

  OSStatus status = AudioObjectSetPropertyData(
    kAudioObjectSystemObject,
    &address,
    0,
    NULL,
    sizeof(device),
    &device
  );

  if (status != noErr) {
    fprintf(stderr, "failed to set default output device: %d\n", (int)status);
    return 1;
  }

  printf("default output device set to %u\n", (unsigned)device);
  return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
  if (argc != 2) {
    fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s <audio-device-id>\n", argv[0]);

  }

  AudioObjectPropertyAddress address = {
    kAudioHardwarePropertyDefaultOutputDevice,
    kAudioObjectPropertyScopeGlobal,
    kAudioObjectPropertyElementMain
  };

    &address,
    0,
    NULL,
    sizeof(device),
    &device
  );

  if (status != noErr) {
    fprintf(stderr, "failed to set default output device: %d\n", (int)status);
    return 1;
  }

  printf("default output device set to %u\n", (unsigned)device);
  return 0;
}

@Composable
fun FlashPlayAndroidApp(store: FlashPlayViewModel) {
    val tracks = store.feedTracks
    var activeTrackId by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var player by remember { mutableStateOf<MediaPlayer?>(null) }
    var playbackError by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }

    fun stopPlayback() {
        player?.runCatching {
            stop()
            release()
        }
        player = null
        activeTrackId = null
    }

    fun playTrack(track: MusicTrack) {
        if (activeTrackId == track.id) {
            stopPlayback()
            return
        }
        playbackError = null
        stopPlayback()
        val nextPlayer = MediaPlayer().apply {
            setAudioAttributes(
                AudioAttributes.Builder()
                    .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
                    .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_MUSIC)
                    .build()
            )
            val localFile = File(track.localPath)
            setDataSource(if (localFile.exists()) localFile.absolutePath else track.audioUrl)
            setOnPreparedListener {
                it.start()
                activeTrackId = track.id
            }
            setOnCompletionListener { stopPlayback() }
            setOnErrorListener { _, _, _ ->
                playbackError = "Playback failed. The local music file may be unavailable."
                stopPlayback()
                true
            }
            prepareAsync()
        }
        player = nextPlayer
    }

    DisposableEffect(Unit) {
        onDispose { stopPlayback() }
    }

    LaunchedEffect(store.pendingPlayTrackId, tracks) {
        val pending = store.pendingPlayTrackId ?: return@LaunchedEffect
        tracks.firstOrNull { it.id == pending }?.let(::playTrack)
        store.consumePendingPlayTrackId()
    }

    MaterialTheme {
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()

@Composable
fun FlashPlayAndroidApp(store: FlashPlayViewModel) {
    val tracks = store.feedTracks
    var activeTrackId by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var player by remember { mutableStateOf<MediaPlayer?>(null) }
    var playbackError by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }

    fun stopPlayback() {
        player?.runCatching {
            stop()
            release()
        }
        player = null
        activeTrackId = null
    }

    fun playTrack(track: MusicTrack) {
        if (activeTrackId == track.id) {
            stopPlayback()
            return
        }
        playbackError = null
        stopPlayback()
        val nextPlayer = MediaPlayer().apply {
            setAudioAttributes(
                AudioAttributes.Builder()
                    .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
                    .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_MUSIC)
                    .build()
            )
            val localFile = File(track.localPath)
            setDataSource(if (localFile.exists()) localFile.absolutePath else track.audioUrl)
            setOnPreparedListener {
                it.start()
                activeTrackId = track.id
            }
            setOnCompletionListener { stopPlayback() }
            setOnErrorListener { _, _, _ ->
                playbackError = "Playback failed. The local music file may be unavailable."
                stopPlayback()
                true
            }
            prepareAsync()
        }
        player = nextPlayer
    }

    DisposableEffect(Unit) {
        onDispose { stopPlayback() }
    }

        val pending = store.pendingPlayTrackId ?: return@LaunchedEffect
        tracks.firstOrNull { it.id == pending }?.let(::playTrack)
        store.consumePendingPlayTrackId()
    }

    MaterialTheme {
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()

# Image Generation Skill

Generates or edits images for the current project (for example website assets, game assets, UI mockups, product mockups, wireframes, logo design, photorealistic images, or infographics).

## Top-level modes and rules

This skill has exactly two top-level modes:

- **Default built-in tool mode (preferred):** built-in `image_gen` tool for normal image generation, editing, and simple transparent-image requests. Does not require `OPENAI_API_KEY`.
- **Fallback CLI mode:** `scripts/image_gen.py` CLI. Use when the user explicitly asks for the CLI/API/model path, or after the user explicitly confirms a true model-native transparency fallback with `gpt-image-1.5`. Requires `OPENAI_API_KEY`.

Within CLI fallback, the CLI exposes three subcommands:

- `generate`
- `edit`
- `generate-batch`

Rules:
- Use the built-in `image_gen` tool by default for normal image generation and editing requests.
- Do not switch to CLI fallback for ordinary quality, size, or file-path control.
- If the user explicitly asks for a transparent image/background, stay on built-in `image_gen` first: prompt for a flat removable chroma-key background, then remove it locally with the installed helper at `$CODEX_HOME/skills/.system/i<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="3039" />al lifestyle scenes with real texture and natural lighting.
- product-mockup — product/packaging shots, catalog imagery, merch concepts.
- ui-mockup — app/web interface mockups and wireframes; specify the desired fidelity.
- infographic-diagram — diagrams/infographics with structured layout and text.
- scientific-educational — classroom explainers, scientific diagrams, and learning visuals with required labels and accuracy constraints.
- ads-marketing — campaign concepts and ad creatives with audience, brand position, scene, and exact tagline/copy.
- productivity-visual — slide, chart, workflow, and data-heavy business visuals.
- logo-brand — logo/mark exploration, vector-friendly.
- illustration-story — comics, children’s book art, narrative scenes.
- stylized-concept — style-driven concept art, 3D/stylized renders.
- historical-scene — period-accurate/world-knowledge scenes.

Edit:
- text-localization — translate/replace in-image text, preserve layout.

- precise-object-edit — remove/replace a specific element (including interior swaps).
- lighting-weather — time-of-day/season/atmosphere changes only.
- background-extraction — transparent background / clean cutout. Use built-in `image_gen` with chroma-key removal first for simple opaque subjects; ask before using CLI true transparency for complex subjects.
- style-transfer — apply reference style while changing subject/scene.
- compositing — multi-image insert/merge with matched lighting/perspective.
- sketch-to-render — drawing/line art to photoreal render.

# Image Generation Skill

Within CLI fallback, the CLI exposes three subcommands:

- `edit`
- `generate-batch`

Rules:

- Do not switch to CLI fallback for ordinary quality, size, or file-path control.
- If the user explicitly asks for a transparent image/background, stay on built-in `image_gen` first: prompt for a flat removable chroma-key background, then remove it locally with the installed helper at `$CODEX_HOME/skills/.system/i<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="3039" />al lifestyle scenes with real texture and natural lighting.

- ads-marketing — campaign concepts and ad creatives with audience, brand position, scene, and exact tagline/copy.

    private fun analyzeEmotion(text: String): EmotionInsight {
        val value = text.lowercase()
        val mood = when {
            listOf("sad", "tired", "lonely", "难过", "累", "孤独", "失落", "emo").any { value.contains(it) } -> "Tender"
            listOf("angry", "stress", "anxious", "焦虑", "压力", "生气", "烦").any { value.contains(it) } -> "Release"
            listOf("happy", "excited", "love", "开心", "快乐", "兴奋", "喜欢").any { value.contains(it) } -> "Bright"
            listOf("calm", "peace", "安静", "平静", "放松").any { value.contains(it) } -> "Calm"
            else -> "Reflective"
        }
        val energy = when {
            listOf("angry", "excited", "跑", "冲", "燃", "兴奋").any { value.contains(it) } -> "High"
            listOf("tired", "sleep", "累", "困", "安静", "平静").any { value.contains(it) } -> "Low"
            else -> "Medium"
        }
        val direction = when (mood) {
            "Tender" -> "slow piano, soft strings, close and healing melodies"
            "Release" -> "driving drums, dark synth bass, cathartic lift"
            "Bright" -> "sunny pop rhythm, clean piano hooks, warm hand claps"
            "Calm" -> "ambient pads, soft keys, gentle pulse"
            else -> "cinematic lo-fi, warm chords, reflective motion"

                    add(agentMessageFromJson(item))
                }
            }
        }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
    }

            agentMessages.forEach { array.put(it.toJson()) }

package com.museplay.android

import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import java.util.UUID

enum class FlashTab(val label: String) {
    Home("Listen"),
    Create("Create"),
    Agent("Agent"),
    Me("Library")
}

enum class MusicMode(
    val label: String,
    val isInstrumental: Boolean
) {
    Instrumental("Instrumental", true),
    Song("Song", false)
}

data class MusicPalette(
    val accent: Color,
    val primary: Color,
    val secondary: Color
)

data class MusicTrack(
    val id: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
    val title: String,
    val summary: String,
    val prompt: String,
    val audioUrl: String,
    val localPath: String,
    val durationMs: Long?,
    val mode: MusicMode,
    val palette: MusicPalette,
    val creator: String,
    val isGenerated: Boolean = false,
    val isFavorite: Boolean = false
)

data class GeneratedMusic(
    val title: String,
    val summary: String,
    val prompt: String,
    val audioUrl: String,
    val localPath: String,
    val durationMs: Long?,
    val mode: MusicMode,
    val model: String
)

data class AgentMessage(
    val text: String,
    val fromUser: Boolean,
    val mood: String = "Neutral",
    val expression: String = "calm",
    val createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
)

data class MusicRecommendation(
    val title: String,
    val mood: String,
    val prompt: String
)

fun MusicTrack.toJson(): org.json.JSONObject = org.json.JSONObject().apply {
    put("id", id)
    put("title", title)
    put("summary", summary)
    put("prompt", prompt)
    put("audioUrl", audioUrl)
    put("localPath", localPath)
    put("durationMs", durationMs ?: org.json.JSONObject.NULL)
    put("mode", mode.name)
    put("creator", creator)
    put("isGenerated", isGenerated)
    put("isFavorite", isFavorite)
}

fun AgentMessage.toJson(): org.json.JSONObject = org.json.JSONObject().apply {
    put("text", text)
    put("fromUser", fromUser)
    put("mood", mood)
    put("expression", expression)
    put("createdAt", createdAt)
}

fun agentMessageFromJson(json: org.json.JSONObject): AgentMessage {
    return AgentMessage(
        text = json.optString("text"),
        fromUser = json.optBoolean("fromUser"),
        mood = json.optString("mood", "Neutral"),
        expression = json.optString("expression", "calm"),
        createdAt = json.optLong("createdAt", System.currentTimeMillis())
    )
}

fun musicTrackFromJson(json: org.json.JSONObject, palette: MusicPalette): MusicTrack {
    return MusicTrack(
        id = json.optString("id").ifBlank { UUID.randomUUID().toString() },
        title = json.optString("title", "Generated Track"),
        summary = json.optString("summary", "Generated and saved locally."),
        prompt = json.optString("prompt"),
        audioUrl = json.optString("audioUrl"),
        localPath = json.optString("localPath"),
        durationMs = json.optLong("durationMs").takeIf { !json.isNull("durationMs") && it > 0 },
        mode = runCatching { MusicMode.valueOf(json.optString("mode")) }.getOrDefault(MusicMode.Instrumental),
        palette = palette,
        creator = json.optString("creator", "Local"),
        isGenerated = json.optBoolean("isGenerated", true),
        isFavorite = json.optBoolean("isFavorite", false)
    )
}

    private fun analyzeEmotion(text: String): EmotionInsight {
        val value = text.lowercase()
        val mood = when {
            listOf("sad", "tired", "lonely", "难过", "累", "孤独", "失落", "emo").any { value.contains(it) } -> "Tender"
            listOf("angry", "stress", "anxious", "焦虑", "压力", "生气", "烦").any { value.contains(it) } -> "Release"
            listOf("happy", "excited", "love", "开心", "快乐", "兴奋", "喜欢").any { value.contains(it) } -> "Bright"
            listOf("calm", "peace", "安静", "平静", "放松").any { value.contains(it) } -> "Calm"
            else -> "Reflective"
        }
        val energy = when {
            listOf("angry", "excited", "跑", "冲", "燃", "兴奋").any { value.contains(it) } -> "High"
            listOf("tired", "sleep", "累", "困", "安静", "平静").any { value.contains(it) } -> "Low"
            else -> "Medium"
        }
        val direction = when (mood) {
            "Tender" -> "slow piano, soft strings, close and healing melodies"
            "Release" -> "driving drums, dark synth bass, cathartic lift"
            "Bright" -> "sunny pop rhythm, clean piano hooks, warm hand claps"
            "Calm" -> "ambient pads, soft keys, gentle pulse"
            else -> "cinematic lo-fi, warm chords, reflective motion"

    private fun loadAgentHistory(): List<AgentMessage> {
        if (!historyFile.exists()) {
            return listOf(

                    fromUser = false,
                    expression = "happy"
                )

                    val item = array.optJSONObject(index) ?: continue
                    add(agentMessageFromJson(item))
                }
            }
        }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
    }

    private fun saveAgentHistory() {
        runCatching {
            val array = JSONArray()
            agentMessages.forEach { array.put(it.toJson()) }
            historyFile.writeText(array.toString())
        }
    }

package com.museplay.android

import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color

enum class FlashTab(val label: String) {

)

)

)

}

object SampleMusic {

}

fun MusicTrack.toJson(): org.json.JSONObject = org.json.JSONObject().apply {
    put("id", id)
    put("title", title)
    put("summary", summary)
    put("prompt", prompt)
    put("audioUrl", audioUrl)
    put("localPath", localPath)
    put("durationMs", durationMs ?: org.json.JSONObject.NULL)
    put("mode", mode.name)
    put("creator", creator)
    put("isGenerated", isGenerated)
    put("isFavorite", isFavorite)
}

fun AgentMessage.toJson(): org.json.JSONObject = org.json.JSONObject().apply {
    put("text", text)
    put("fromUser", fromUser)
    put("mood", mood)
    put("expression", expression)
    put("createdAt", createdAt)
}

fun agentMessageFromJson(json: org.json.JSONObject): AgentMessage {
    return AgentMessage(
        text = json.optString("text"),
        fromUser = json.optBoolean("fromUser"),
        mood = json.optString("mood", "Neutral"),
        expression = json.optString("expression", "calm"),
        createdAt = json.optLong("createdAt", System.currentTimeMillis())
    )
}

fun musicTrackFromJson(json: org.json.JSONObject, palette: MusicPalette): MusicTrack {
    return MusicTrack(
        id = json.optString("id").ifBlank { UUID.randomUUID().toString() },
        title = json.optString("title", "Generated Track"),
        summary = json.optString("summary", "Generated and saved locally."),
        prompt = json.optString("prompt"),
        audioUrl = json.optString("audioUrl"),
        localPath = json.optString("localPath"),
        durationMs = json.optLong("durationMs").takeIf { !json.isNull("durationMs") && it > 0 },
        mode = runCatching { MusicMode.valueOf(json.optString("mode")) }.getOrDefault(MusicMode.Instrumental),
        palette = palette,
        creator = json.optString("creator", "Local"),
        isGenerated = json.optBoolean("isGenerated", true),
        isFavorite = json.optBoolean("isFavorite", false)
    )
}

@Composable
private fun BottomBar(
    selectedTab: FlashTab,
    onSelect: (FlashTab) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    Row(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.navigationBars)
            .padding(horizontal = 18.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(24.dp))
            .background(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.96f))
            .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
    ) {
        FlashTab.entries.forEach { tab ->
            val selected = tab == selectedTab
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .weight(1f)
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(18.dp))
                    .background(if (selected) FlashPlayPalette.Brand else Color.Transparent)
                    .clickable { onSelect(tab) }
                    .padding(vertical = 12.dp),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Text(
                    tab.label,
                    color = if (selected) Color.White else FlashPlayPalette.Ink,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontSize = 13.sp
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

) {

                modifier = Modifier

                    color = if (selected) Color.White else FlashPlayPalette.Ink,

                    fontSize = 13.sp

            }
        }
    }

@Composable
private fun TrackCard(
    track: MusicTrack,
    isPlaying: Boolean,
    immersive: Boolean,
    onPlay: () -> Unit,
    onFavorite: () -> Unit
) {
    Card(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .then(if (immersive) Modifier.height(520.dp) else Modifier),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
        colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = Color.White)
    ) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .background(Brush.linearGradient(listOf(track.palette.primary, track.palette.secondary)))
                .padding(16.dp),
            verticalArrangement = if (immersive) Arrangement.SpaceBetween else Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
        ) {
            Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                        Text(
                            track.title,
                            color = FlashPlayPalette.Ink,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                            font<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="897" />sage.fromUser) Color.White else FlashPlayPalette.Ink,
                    fontSize = 14.sp,
                    lineHeight = 20.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold
                )
                Text(
                    text = if (message.fromUser) "You" else "MuseCat · ${message.expression}",
                    color = if (message.fromUser) Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.72f) else FlashPlayPalette.Ink.copy(alpha = 0.45f),
                    fontSize = 11.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun RecommendationCard(
    recommendation: MusicRecommendation,
    onUse: () -> Unit
) {
    Surface(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
        color = Color.White
    ) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
        ) {
            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    Text(recommendation.title, fontSize = 20.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, color = FlashPlayPalette.Ink)
                    Text(recommendation.mood, fontSize = 12.sp, color = FlashPlayPalette.Brand, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
                Button(
                    onClick = onUse,
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
                    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = FlashPlayPalette.Brand)
                ) {
                    Text("Use", fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                }
            }
            Text(
                recommendation.prompt,
                color = FlashPlayPalette.Ink.copy(alpha = 0.66f),
                fontSize = 13.sp,
                lineHeight = 18.sp
            )
        }
    }
}

fun loadProperties(fileName: String): Properties = Properties().apply {
    val file = rootProject.file(fileName)
    if (file.exists()) {
        file.inputStream().use(::load)
    }
}

val localProperties = loadProperties("local.properties")
val secretProperties = loadProperties("secrets.properties")

fun quote(value: String): String = "\"" + value
    .replace("\\", "\\\\")
    .replace("\"", "\\\"") + "\""

fun secret(name: String): String {
    val env = providers.environmentVariable(name).orNull
    if (!env.isNullOrBlank()) return env
    val localSecret = secretProperties.getProperty(name)
    if (!localSecret.isNullOrBlank()) return localSecret
    return localProperties.getProperty(name, "")
}

+@Composable
+private fun MusicLottieStage(
+    track: MusicTrack,
+    isPlaying: Boolean,
+    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
+) {
+    val asset = remember(track.id) { lottieAssetFor(track) }
+    val composition by rememberLottieComposition(LottieCompositionSpec.Asset(asset))
+    val progress by animateLottieCompositionAsState(
+        composition = composition,
+        iterations = LottieConstants.IterateForever,
+        isPlaying = isPlaying
+    )
+
+    Surface(
+        modifier = modifier
+            .fillMaxWidth()
+            .height(260.dp),
+        shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
+        color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.28f)
+    ) {
+        Box(contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
+            LottieAnimation(
+                composition = composition,
+                progress = { progress },
+                modifier = Modifier.size(238.dp)
+            )
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+private fun lottieAssetFor(track: MusicTrack): String {
+    val assets = listOf(
+        "lottie_music/equalizer_neon.json",
+        "lottie_music/pulse_orbit.json",
+        "lottie_music/vinyl_spin.json",
+        "lottie_music/dream_dots.json",
+        "lottie_music/wave_stack.json",
+        "lottie_music/soft_meter.json"
+    )
+    val index = kotlin.math.abs(track.id.hashCode()) % assets.size
+    return assets[index]
+}

fun loadProperties(fileName: String): Properties = Properties().apply {
    val file = rootProject.file(fileName)
    if (file.exists()) {
        file.inputStream().use(::load)
    }
}

val localProperties = loadProperties("local.properties")
val secretProperties = loadProperties("secrets.properties")

fun quote(value: String): String = "\"" + value
    .replace("\\", "\\\\")
    .replace("\"", "\\\"") + "\""

fun secret(name: String): String {
    val env = providers.environmentVariable(name).orNull
    if (!env.isNullOrBlank()) return env
    val localSecret = secretProperties.getProperty(name)
    if (!localSecret.isNullOrBlank()) return localSecret
    return localProperties.getProperty(name, "")
}

+@Composable
+private fun MusicLottieStage(
+    track: MusicTrack,
+    isPlaying: Boolean,
+    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
+) {
+    val asset = remember(track.id) { lottieAssetFor(track) }
+    val composition by rememberLottieComposition(LottieCompositionSpec.Asset(asset))
+    val progress by animateLottieCompositionAsState(
+        composition = composition,
+        iterations = LottieConstants.IterateForever,
+        isPlaying = isPlaying
+    )
+
+    Surface(
+        modifier = modifier
+            .fillMaxWidth()
+            .height(260.dp),
+        shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
+        color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.28f)
+    ) {
+        Box(contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
+            LottieAnimation(
+                composition = composition,
+                progress = { progress },
+                modifier = Modifier.size(238.dp)
+            )
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+private fun lottieAssetFor(track: MusicTrack): String {
+    val assets = listOf(
+        "lottie_music/equalizer_neon.json",
+        "lottie_music/pulse_orbit.json",
+        "lottie_music/vinyl_spin.json",
+        "lottie_music/dream_dots.json",
+        "lottie_music/wave_stack.json",
+        "lottie_music/soft_meter.json"
+    )
+    val index = kotlin.math.abs(track.id.hashCode()) % assets.size
+    return assets[index]
+}

@Composable
private fun FeedWaveform(
    track: MusicTrack,
    isPlaying: Boolean,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    val heights = remember(track.id) {
        listOf(38, 74, 54, 96, 44, 82, 64, 112, 52, 88, 70, 42, 104, 58, 78, 46)
    }
    Row(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .height(124.dp)
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .background(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.38f))
            .padding(horizontal = 14.dp),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
    ) {
        heights.forEachIndexed { index, height ->
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .size(width = 8.dp, height = (if (isPlaying && index % 3 == 0) height + 14 else height).dp)
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                    .background(if (isPlaying) FlashPlayPalette.Brand else FlashPlayPalette.Ink.copy(alpha = 0.34f))
            )
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun FeedWaveform(
    track: MusicTrack,
    isPlaying: Boolean,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    val heights = remember(track.id) {
        listOf(38, 74, 54, 96, 44, 82, 64, 112, 52, 88, 70, 42, 104, 58, 78, 46)
    }
    Row(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .height(124.dp)
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .background(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.38f))
            .padding(horizontal = 14.dp),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
    ) {
        heights.forEachIndexed { index, height ->
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .size(width = 8.dp, height = (if (isPlaying && index % 3 == 0) height + 14 else height).dp)
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                    .background(if (isPlaying) FlashPlayPalette.Brand else FlashPlayPalette.Ink.copy(alpha = 0.34f))
            )
        }
    }
}

[524] assistant: 我搜了 `uiverse-io/galaxy`。结论：它是 Uiverse 的开源 UI 库镜像，主要是 **HTML/CSS/Tailwind**，不是 Android 原生组件，所以不能直接复制进 APK，但很多动效可以用 Compose 复刻。repo 里有 Buttons、Cards、Inputs、Notifications、Patterns、loaders 等分类，并且 MIT 许可，可改造使用。来源：[uiverse-io/galaxy](https://github.com/uiverse-io/galaxy)。

适合本 App 的优先级：

1. **loaders**
最适合。可用于 `Generate music` 生成中状态、Agent 思考中、音乐上传/下载等待态。建议复刻成音乐频谱、旋转唱片、脉冲圆环，比现在普通 loading 更像音乐产品。

2. **Buttons**
适合替换当前 `Generate music`、`Shuffle`、Agent 发送按钮。可做发光边框、按压弹性、液态 hover 的移动端版本，但不要太花，保留极简。

3. **Cards**
适合 Library 里的音乐卡片、Agent 推荐音乐卡片、Create 页 Prompt bank 卡片。可以借鉴玻璃拟态、渐变边框、hover lift，但 Compose 里要改成 tap/press 动效。

4. **Toggle-switches / Radio-buttons**
适合 `Instrumental / Song` 模式切换。现在 FilterChip 比较普通，可以改成更有质感的 segmented control。

5. **Inputs / Forms**
适合 Create 页的 Track title 和 Music prompt 输入框。可以做 focus 发光边框、浮动 label、轻微 scale，但不建议使用太复杂的网页输入框效果。

6. **Notifications**
适合生成成功、失败、保存本地、API 错误的 Toast/Notice。可以做滑入、弹性、颜色分级。

不建议优先用：

- **Patterns**：大多是背景装饰，容易让音乐 feed 变乱。
- **Checkboxes**：当前 App 不太需要。
- 复杂 CSS 3D 卡片：Android Compose 复刻成本高，性能也未必好。

我的建议：先把 `loaders + buttons + mode toggle + notice` 四类做进 App，收益最大。它们能直接改善“生成音乐等待、点击手感、创建页质感、错误反馈”。

+private fun GalaxyMiniLoader() {
+    val infinite = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "mini-loader")
+    val phase by infinite.animateFloat(
+        initialValue = 0f,
+        targetValue = 1f,
+        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(animation = tween(780), repeatMode = RepeatMode.Restart),
+        label = "mini-loader-phase"
+    )

+        modifier = Modifier.size(width = 30.dp, height = 22.dp),
+        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
+        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
+    ) {
+        repeat(4) { index ->
+            val wave = kotlin.math.sin((phase * 360f + index * 55f) * Math.PI / 180f).toFloat()
+            Box(
+                modifier = Modifier
+                    .size(width = 4.dp, height = (10 + 8 * ((wave + 1f) / 2f)).dp)
+                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
+                    .background(Color.White)
+            )
+        }
+    }
+}

[524] assistant: 我搜了 `uiverse-io/galaxy`。结论：它是 Uiverse 的开源 UI 库镜像，主要是 **HTML/CSS/Tailwind**，不是 Android 原生组件，所以不能直接复制进 APK，但很多动效可以用 Compose 复刻。repo 里有 Buttons、Cards、Inputs、Notifications、Patterns、loaders 等分类，并且 MIT 许可，可改造使用。来源：[uiverse-io/galaxy](https://github.com/uiverse-io/galaxy)。

适合本 App 的优先级：

1. **loaders**
最适合。可用于 `Generate music` 生成中状态、Agent 思考中、音乐上传/下载等待态。建议复刻成音乐频谱、旋转唱片、脉冲圆环，比现在普通 loading 更像音乐产品。

2. **Buttons**
适合替换当前 `Generate music`、`Shuffle`、Agent 发送按钮。可做发光边框、按压弹性、液态 hover 的移动端版本，但不要太花，保留极简。

3. **Cards**
适合 Library 里的音乐卡片、Agent 推荐音乐卡片、Create 页 Prompt bank 卡片。可以借鉴玻璃拟态、渐变边框、hover lift，但 Compose 里要改成 tap/press 动效。

4. **Toggle-switches / Radio-buttons**
适合 `Instrumental / Song` 模式切换。现在 FilterChip 比较普通，可以改成更有质感的 segmented control。

5. **Inputs / Forms**
适合 Create 页的 Track title 和 Music prompt 输入框。可以做 focus 发光边框、浮动 label、轻微 scale，但不建议使用太复杂的网页输入框效果。

6. **Notifications**
适合生成成功、失败、保存本地、API 错误的 Toast/Notice。可以做滑入、弹性、颜色分级。

不建议优先用：

- **Patterns**：大多是背景装饰，容易让音乐 feed 变乱。
- **Checkboxes**：当前 App 不太需要。
- 复杂 CSS 3D 卡片：Android Compose 复刻成本高，性能也未必好。

+private fun GalaxyMiniLoader() {
+    val infinite = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "mini-loader")
+    val phase by infinite.animateFloat(
+        initialValue = 0f,
+        targetValue = 1f,
+        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(animation = tween(780), repeatMode = RepeatMode.Restart),
+        label = "mini-loader-phase"
+    )
+    Row(
+        modifier = Modifier.size(width = 30.dp, height = 22.dp),
+        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
+        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
+    ) {
+        repeat(4) { index ->
+            val wave = kotlin.math.sin((phase * 360f + index * 55f) * Math.PI / 180f).toFloat()
+            Box(
+                modifier = Modifier
+                    .size(width = 4.dp, height = (10 + 8 * ((wave + 1f) / 2f)).dp)
+                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
+                    .background(Color.White)
+            )
+        }
+    }
+}

@Composable
private fun GalaxyMiniLoader() {
    val infinite = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "mini-loader")
    val phase by infinite.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0f,
        targetValue = 1f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(animation = tween(780), repeatMode = RepeatMode.Restart),
        label = "mini-loader-phase"
    )
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.size(width = 30.dp, height = 22.dp),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
    ) {
        repeat(4) { index ->
            val wave = kotlin.math.sin((phase * 360f + index * 55f) * Math.PI / 180f).toFloat()
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .size(width = 4.dp, height = (10 + 8 * ((wave + 1f) / 2f)).dp)
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
                    .background(Color.White)
            )
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun GalaxyMiniLoader() {
    val infinite = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "mini-loader")
    val phase by infinite.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0f,
        targetValue = 1f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(animation = tween(780), repeatMode = RepeatMode.Restart),
        label = "mini-loader-phase"
    )
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.size(width = 30.dp, height = 22.dp),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
    ) {
        repeat(4) { index ->
            val wave = kotlin.math.sin((phase * 360f + index * 55f) * Math.PI / 180f).toFloat()
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .size(width = 4.dp, height = (10 + 8 * ((wave + 1f) / 2f)).dp)
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
                    .background(Color.White)
            )
        }
    }
}

[150] assistant: 我已经确认当前主要交互：Listen 是竖滑 feed，Create 是提示词生成，Agent 是情绪对话，Library 是收藏/生成库。下面我用 PM 视角把问题按用户任务和优先级拆开。

[151] assistant: 我调用并参考了 `/Users/vincet/.openclaw/workspace/skills/product-manager/SKILL.md` 的 PM 规则来分析。结论：MusePlay 现在功能方向对，但交互还像“功能集合”，需要更像“AI 音乐体验闭环”。

**核心问题**
用户的主要 Job 应该是：表达情绪或场景 → 快速得到适合自己的音乐 → 立即播放/收藏/再生成变体。  
现在 Listen、Create、Agent、Library 四个模块都有了，但用户旅程还断：Agent 的情绪理解、Create 的生成、Listen 的消费 feed 没有完全串起来。

**最高优先级改进**

1. **Create 生成前缺少明确预期**
现在用户填写 prompt 后点击生成，但不知道会等多久、生成什么类型、失败后怎么办。  
建议增加：预计耗时、当前步骤文案，例如 `Understanding mood / Composing / Saving locally`，进度条分阶段而不是单纯百分比。

2. **Agent 和生成音乐没有形成强闭环**
Agent 可以聊天和推荐，但它应该是产品灵魂。  
建议：Agent 对话后直接出现 2-3 个“一键生成”音乐卡片，例如 `安慰我 / 帮我提神 / 让我平静`。用户不应该再手动去 Create 填 prompt。

3. **Listen feed 的右侧按钮太少也太弱**
你要求只保留收藏和音量是对的，但缺少一个 AI 音乐 app 的关键动作：`生成相似` 或 `用这个感觉再来一首`。  
建议不放在右侧，可以放在底部标题附近做一个极简按钮：`Remix`。这是提高生成次数和留存的核心入口。

4. **默认播放体验需要更可靠**
用户已经多次反馈“没声音”。这是 P0 体验风险。  
建议在 app 内加一个首次播放检查：音量为 0、模拟器/设备静音、播放失败时，显示极简 toast 或底部提示：`Audio route unavailable` / `Tap to retry playback`。不要让用户猜。

5. **Library 价值不足**
Library 现在像列表，不像用户的个人音乐空间。  
建议分成三个轻量区：`Generated`、`Favorites`、`Mood History`。尤其 Mood History 可以把 Agent 情绪对话和生成音乐绑定起来。

**中优先级改进**

1. **生成失败恢复**
失败后应该保留用户输入，并提供 `Retry`、`Switch to instrumental`、`Random prompt` 三个恢复动作。现在错误只是提示，行动不够明确。

2. **Prompt 随机很好，但缺少“为什么适合我”**
每次进入 Create 随机 prompt 会有新鲜感，但用户可能迷失。  
建议显示一个很短的 mood tag，比如 `calm night`、`bright run`、`soft healing`，让随机不是随机噪音。

3. **Feed 动画要和音乐状态绑定**
Lottie/Canvas 动画不只是装饰，应该播放时更活跃、暂停时静止或变慢、切歌时有过渡。这样用户能直观看到“音乐活着”。

4. **收藏之后缺少反馈**
点击收藏应有非常轻的状态反馈：按钮弹一下、短文本 `Saved`，并确保 Library 里立刻可见。

5. **底部 Tab 命名可以更产品化**
`Listen / Create / Agent / Library` 清楚，但 Agent 如果是核心，可以考虑改成 `Muse` 或 `Mood`，更像超级音乐 app，而不是工具页。

**建议路线图**
Now：修播放可靠性、Create 分阶段进度、Agent 一键生成卡片、失败恢复。  
Next：Feed 增加 Remix、Library 情绪历史、动画绑定播放状态。  
Later：个性化推荐、用户画像、每日情绪音乐流、社交/分享。

我会把第一轮产品优化的优先级定为：**让 Agent 成为入口，让 Feed 成为消费，让 Remix 成为循环**。这是最有可能把 app 从“能生成音乐”推进到“让用户持续想玩”的交互骨架。

@Composable
private fun ListenScreen(
    dailyVibe: String,
    tracks: List<MusicTrack>,
    activeTrackId: String?,
    playbackError: String?,
    playbackVolume: Float,
    onPlay: (MusicTrack) -> Unit,
    onFavorite: (String) -> Unit,
    onVolumeChange: (Float) -> Unit
) {
    var currentIndex by remember(tracks.size) { mutableStateOf(0) }
    var dragTotal by remember { mutableStateOf(0f) }
    var showVolumePanel by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val currentTrack = tracks.getOrNull(currentIndex.coerceIn(0, (tracks.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)))

    LaunchedEffect(currentTrack?.id) {
        val track = currentTrack ?: return@LaunchedEffect

@Composable
private fun MusicLottieStage(
    track: MusicTrack,
    isPlaying: Boolean,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    val asset = remember(track.id) { lottieAssetFor(track) }
    val visualIndex = remember(track.id) { kotlin.math.abs(track.id.hashCode()) % 6 }
    val composition by rememberLottieComposition(LottieCompositionSpec.Asset(asset))
    val progress by animateLottieCompositionAsState(
        composition = composition,
        iterations = LottieConstants.IterateForever,
        isPlaying = isPlaying
    )

    Surface(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .height(260.dp),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
        color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.42f)
    ) {
        Box(contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
            MusicCanvasAnimation(
                track = track,
                visualIndex = visualIndex,
                isPlaying = isPlaying,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
            )
            LottieAnimation(
                composition = composition,
                progress = { progress },
                modifier = Modifier
                    .size(238.dp)
                    .graphicsLayer { alpha = if (composition == null) 0f else 0.94f }
            )
        }
    }
}

                    drawCircle(colors[i % colors.size], radius = (7 + (i % 3) * 3).dp.toPx(), center = Offset(x, y))

private fun lottieAssetFor(track: MusicTrack): String {
    val assets = listOf(
        "lottie_music/equalizer_neon.json",
        "lottie_music/pulse_orbit.json",
        "lottie_music/vinyl_spin.json",
        "lottie_music/dream_dots.json",
        "lottie_music/wave_stack.json",
        "lottie_music/soft_meter.json"
    )
    val index = kotlin.math.abs(track.id.hashCode()) % assets.size
    return assets[index]
}

fun MusicTrack.toJson(): org.json.JSONObject = org.json.JSONObject().apply {
    put("id", id)
    put("title", title)
    put("summary", summary)
    put("prompt", prompt)
    put("audioUrl", audioUrl)
    put("localPath", localPath)
    put("durationMs", durationMs ?: org.json.JSONObject.NULL)
    put("mode", mode.name)
    put("creator", creator)
    put("isGenerated", isGenerated)
    put("isFavorite", isFavorite)
}

fun AgentMessage.toJson(): org.json.JSONObject = org.json.JSONObject().apply {
    put("text", text)
    put("fromUser", fromUser)
    put("mood", mood)
    put("expression", expression)
    put("createdAt", createdAt)
}

fun agentMessageFromJson(json: org.json.JSONObject): AgentMessage {
    return AgentMessage(
        text = json.optString("text"),
        fromUser = json.optBoolean("fromUser"),
        mood = json.optString("mood", "Neutral"),
        expression = json.optString("expression", "calm"),
        createdAt = json.optLong("createdAt", System.currentTimeMillis())
    )
}

fun musicTrackFromJson(json: org.json.JSONObject, palette: MusicPalette): MusicTrack {
    return MusicTrack(
        id = json.optString("id").ifBlank { UUID.randomUUID().toString() },
        title = json.optString("title", "Generated Track"),
        summary = json.optString("summary", "Generated and saved locally."),
        prompt = json.optString("prompt"),
        audioUrl = json.optString("audioUrl"),
        localPath = json.optString("localPath"),
        durationMs = json.optLong("durationMs").takeIf { !json.isNull("durationMs") && it > 0 },
        mode = runCatching { MusicMode.valueOf(json.optString("mode")) }.getOrDefault(MusicMode.Instrumental),
        palette = palette,
        creator = json.optString("creator", "Local"),
        isGenerated = json.optBoolean("isGenerated", true),
        isFavorite = json.optBoolean("isFavorite", false)
    )
}

[150] assistant: 我已经确认当前主要交互：Listen 是竖滑 feed，Create 是提示词生成，Agent 是情绪对话，Library 是收藏/生成库。下面我用 PM 视角把问题按用户任务和优先级拆开。

[151] assistant: 我调用并参考了 `/Users/vincet/.openclaw/workspace/skills/product-manager/SKILL.md` 的 PM 规则来分析。结论：MusePlay 现在功能方向对，但交互还像“功能集合”，需要更像“AI 音乐体验闭环”。

**核心问题**
用户的主要 Job 应该是：表达情绪或场景 → 快速得到适合自己的音乐 → 立即播放/收藏/再生成变体。  
现在 Listen、Create、Agent、Library 四个模块都有了，但用户旅程还断：Agent 的情绪理解、Create 的生成、Listen 的消费 feed 没有完全串起来。

**最高优先级改进**

1. **Create 生成前缺少明确预期**
现在用户填写 prompt 后点击生成，但不知道会等多久、生成什么类型、失败后怎么办。  
建议增加：预计耗时、当前步骤文案，例如 `Understanding mood / Composing / Saving locally`，进度条分阶段而不是单纯百分比。

2. **Agent 和生成音乐没有形成强闭环**
Agent 可以聊天和推荐，但它应该是产品灵魂。  
建议：Agent 对话后直接出现 2-3 个“一键生成”音乐卡片，例如 `安慰我 / 帮我提神 / 让我平静`。用户不应该再手动去 Create 填 prompt。

3. **Listen feed 的右侧按钮太少也太弱**
你要求只保留收藏和音量是对的，但缺少一个 AI 音乐 app 的关键动作：`生成相似` 或 `用这个感觉再来一首`。  
建议不放在右侧，可以放在底部标题附近做一个极简按钮：`Remix`。这是提高生成次数和留存的核心入口。

4. **默认播放体验需要更可靠**
用户已经多次反馈“没声音”。这是 P0 体验风险。  
建议在 app 内加一个首次播放检查：音量为 0、模拟器/设备静音、播放失败时，显示极简 toast 或底部提示：`Audio route unavailable` / `Tap to retry playback`。不要让用户猜。

5. **Library 价值不足**
Library 现在像列表，不像用户的个人音乐空间。  
建议分成三个轻量区：`Generated`、`Favorites`、`Mood History`。尤其 Mood History 可以把 Agent 情绪对话和生成音乐绑定起来。

**中优先级改进**

1. **生成失败恢复**
失败后应该保留用户输入，并提供 `Retry`、`Switch to instrumental`、`Random prompt` 三个恢复动作。现在错误只是提示，行动不够明确。

2. **Prompt 随机很好，但缺少“为什么适合我”**
每次进入 Create 随机 prompt 会有新鲜感，但用户可能迷失。  
建议显示一个很短的 mood tag，比如 `calm night`、`bright run`、`soft healing`，让随机不是随机噪音。

3. **Feed 动画要和音乐状态绑定**
Lottie/Canvas 动画不只是装饰，应该播放时更活跃、暂停时静止或变慢、切歌时有过渡。这样用户能直观看到“音乐活着”。

4. **收藏之后缺少反馈**
点击收藏应有非常轻的状态反馈：按钮弹一下、短文本 `Saved`，并确保 Library 里立刻可见。

5. **底部 Tab 命名可以更产品化**
`Listen / Create / Agent / Library` 清楚，但 Agent 如果是核心，可以考虑改成 `Muse` 或 `Mood`，更像超级音乐 app，而不是工具页。

**建议路线图**
Now：修播放可靠性、Create 分阶段进度、Agent 一键生成卡片、失败恢复。  
Next：Feed 增加 Remix、Library 情绪历史、动画绑定播放状态。  
Later：个性化推荐、用户画像、每日情绪音乐流、社交/分享。

我会把第一轮产品优化的优先级定为：**让 Agent 成为入口，让 Feed 成为消费，让 Remix 成为循环**。这是最有可能把 app 从“能生成音乐”推进到“让用户持续想玩”的交互骨架。

@Composable
private fun ListenScreen(
    dailyVibe: String,
    tracks: List<MusicTrack>,
    activeTrackId: String?,
    playbackError: String?,
    playbackVolume: Float,
    onPlay: (MusicTrack) -> Unit,
    onFavorite: (String) -> Unit,
    onVolumeChange: (Float) -> Unit
) {
    var currentIndex by remember(tracks.size) { mutableStateOf(0) }
    var dragTotal by remember { mutableStateOf(0f) }
    var showVolumePanel by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val currentTrack = tracks.getOrNull(currentIndex.coerceIn(0, (tracks.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)))

    LaunchedEffect(currentTrack?.id) {
        val track = currentTrack ?: return@LaunchedEffect
        showVolumePanel = false
        if (activeTrackId != track.id) {
            onPlay(track)
        }
    }

    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .background(currentTrack?.palette?.primary ?: FlashPlayPalette.Background)

                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .padding(20.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
            ) {
                EmptyState(
                    title = "No music yet",
                    body = "Create a track, then come back here to listen."
                )
            }
        } else {
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
             <truncated omitted_approx_tokens="1275" />(it, color = Color(0xFFB42318), fontSize = 12.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    }
                }

                Column(
                    modifier = Modifier

                        .padding(end = 18.dp),
                    horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(18.dp)
                ) {
                    RoundButton(text = if (currentTrack.isFavorite) "★" else "☆", onClick = { onFavorite(currentTrack.id) })
                    VolumeRoundButton(volume = playbackVolume, onClick = { showVolumePanel = !showVolumePanel })

@Composable
private fun MusicLottieStage(
    track: MusicTrack,
    isPlaying: Boolean,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    val asset = remember(track.id) { lottieAssetFor(track) }
    val visualIndex = remember(track.id) { kotlin.math.abs(track.id.hashCode()) % 6 }
    val composition by rememberLottieComposition(LottieCompositionSpec.Asset(asset))
    val progress by animateLottieCompositionAsState(
        composition = composition,
        iterations = LottieConstants.IterateForever,
        isPlaying = isPlaying
    )

    Surface(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .height(260.dp),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
        color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.42f)
    ) {
        Box(contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
            MusicCanvasAnimation(
                track = track,
                visualIndex = visualIndex,
                isPlaying = isPlaying,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
            )
            LottieAnimation(
                composition = composition,
                progress = { progress },
                modifier = Modifier
                    .size(238.dp)
                    .graphicsLayer { alpha = if (composition == null) 0f else 0.94f }
            )
        }
    }
}

private fun MusicCanvasAnimation(

                    drawCircle(colors[i % colors.size], radius = (7 + (i % 3) * 3).dp.toPx(), center = Offset(x, y))

}

private fun lottieAssetFor(track: MusicTrack): String {
    val assets = listOf(
        "lottie_music/equalizer_neon.json",
        "lottie_music/pulse_orbit.json",
        "lottie_music/vinyl_spin.json",
        "lottie_music/dream_dots.json",
        "lottie_music/wave_stack.json",
        "lottie_music/soft_meter.json"
    )
    val index = kotlin.math.abs(track.id.hashCode()) % assets.size
    return assets[index]
}
