fun MusicTrack.toJson(): org.json.JSONObject = org.json.JSONObject().apply {
    put("id", id)
    put("title", title)
    put("summary", summary)
    put("prompt", prompt)
    put("audioUrl", audioUrl)
    put("localPath", localPath)
    put("durationMs", durationMs ?: org.json.JSONObject.NULL)
    put("mode", mode.name)
    put("creator", creator)
    put("isGenerated", isGenerated)
    put("isFavorite", isFavorite)
}

fun AgentMessage.toJson(): org.json.JSONObject = org.json.JSONObject().apply {
    put("text", text)
    put("fromUser", fromUser)
    put("mood", mood)
    put("expression", expression)
    put("createdAt", createdAt)
}

fun agentMessageFromJson(json: org.json.JSONObject): AgentMessage {
    return AgentMessage(
        text = json.optString("text"),
        fromUser = json.optBoolean("fromUser"),
        mood = json.optString("mood", "Neutral"),
        expression = json.optString("expression", "calm"),
        createdAt = json.optLong("createdAt", System.currentTimeMillis())
    )
}

fun musicTrackFromJson(json: org.json.JSONObject, palette: MusicPalette): MusicTrack {
    return MusicTrack(
        id = json.optString("id").ifBlank { UUID.randomUUID().toString() },
        title = json.optString("title", "Generated Track"),
        summary = json.optString("summary", "Generated and saved locally."),
        prompt = json.optString("prompt"),
        audioUrl = json.optString("audioUrl"),
        localPath = json.optString("localPath"),
        durationMs = json.optLong("durationMs").takeIf { !json.isNull("durationMs") && it > 0 },
        mode = runCatching { MusicMode.valueOf(json.optString("mode")) }.getOrDefault(MusicMode.Instrumental),
        palette = palette,
        creator = json.optString("creator", "Local"),
        isGenerated = json.optBoolean("isGenerated", true),
        isFavorite = json.optBoolean("isFavorite", false)
    )
}

- 收藏反馈：点击收藏有弹性反馈，图标立即变为 `★`，并短暂显示 Saved/Removed，Library 数据也同步更新。

验证：`./gradlew assembleDebug` 编译成功，APK 已安装到模拟器并启动；UI 树确认底部已显示 `Mood`，收藏点击后图标已切换为 `★`。

    private fun defaultSongLyrics(title: String): String {
        val cleanTitle = title.ifBlank { "This Little Song" }
        return """
            [Verse]
            I keep a little light inside
            Walking with the rhythm of the sky
            Every quiet word I could not say
            Turns into a sound and flies away

            [Chorus]
            $cleanTitle, carry me tonight
            Lift my heart and color it with light
            If the world is moving fast and long
            I will find myself inside this song
        """.trimIndent()
    }

    private fun randomPromptSeed(): PromptSeed {
        return promptBank.getOrNull(Random.nextInt(promptBank.size.coerceAtLeast(1)))
            ?: PromptSeed(
                title = "Fresh Signal",
                prompt = "A polished 30-second instrumental track, bright synth melody, warm bass, crisp drums, hopeful modern energy, no vocals."
            )
    }

    private fun loadPromptBank(): List<PromptSeed> {
        val app = getApplication<Application>()
        return runCatching {
            val text = app.assets.open("prompt_bank.json")
                .bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)
                .use { it.readText() }
            val array = JSONArray(text)
            buildList {
                for (index in 0 until array.length()) {
                    val item = array.optJSONObject(index) ?: continue
                    val title = item.optString("title").trim()
                    val prompt = item.optString("prompt").trim()
                    if (title.isNotEmpty() && prompt.isNotEmpty()) {
                        add(PromptSeed(title = title, prompt = prompt))
                    }
                }
            }
        }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
    }

[362] user: apk文件为什么不能上传


[363] assistant: APK 不是不能上传，而是我刚才按“源码仓库”的安全/工程习惯默认忽略了它。

原因主要有三个：

1. **APK 是构建产物**
   GitHub 源码仓库通常只放代码、配置、资源文件；APK 可以随时由源码重新编译出来。把 APK 放进 Git 会让仓库变大，也容易每次构建都产生二进制 diff。

2. **避免误上传敏感内容**
   APK 里可能包含编译进 `BuildConfig` 的配置，比如 API key。如果当前 debug APK 已经把本地 MiniMax key 编译进去，直接上传 APK 风险比上传源码更高。

[363] assistant: APK 不是不能上传，而是我刚才按“源码仓库”的安全/工程习惯默认忽略了它。

原因主要有三个：

1. **APK 是构建产物**
   GitHub 源码仓库通常只放代码、配置、资源文件；APK 可以随时由源码重新编译出来。把 APK 放进 Git 会让仓库变大，也容易每次构建都产生二进制 diff。

2. **避免误上传敏感内容**
   APK 里可能包含编译进 `BuildConfig` 的配置，比如 API key。如果当前 debug APK 已经把本地 MiniMax key 编译进去，直接上传 APK 风险比上传源码更高。

3. **更推荐用 Release 附件**
   如果要分发 APK，最佳方式是 GitHub Releases：源码仓库保持干净，APK 作为某个版本的 release artifact 上传，比如 `v0.1.0 app-debug.apk`。

如果你要，我可以继续做两种方式之一：

- **推荐**：创建 GitHub Release，并上传 APK 附件。
- **不推荐但可以**：把 APK 提交进仓库。

---
name: remotion-best-practices
description: Best practices for Remotion - Video creation in React
metadata:
  tags: remotion, video, react, animation, composition
---

## When to use

Use this skills whenever you are dealing with Remotion code to obtain the domain-specific knowledge.

## New project setup

When in an empty folder or workspace with no existing Remotion project, scaffold one using:

```bash
npx create-video@latest --yes --blank --no-tailwind my-video
```

Replace `my-video` with a suitable project name.

## Starting preview

Start the Remotion Studio to preview a video:

```bash
npx remotion studio
```

## Optional: one-frame render check

You can render a single frame with the CLI to sanity-check layout, colors, or timing.  
Skip it for trivial edits, pure refactors, or when you already have enough confidence from Studio or prior renders.

```bash
npx remotion still [composition-id] --scale=0.25 --frame=30
```

At 30 fps, `--frame=30` is the one-second mark (`--frame` is zero-based).

## Captions

When dealing with captions or subtitles, load the [./rules/subtitles.md](./rules/subtitles.md) file for more information.

## Using FFmpeg

For some video operations, such as trimming videos or detecting silence, FFmpeg should be used. Load the [./rules/ffmpeg.md](./rules/ffmpeg.md) file for more information.

## Silence detection

When needing to detect and trim silent segments from video or audio files, load the [./rules/silence-detection.md](./rules/silence-detection.md) file.

## Audio visualization

When needing to visualize audio (spectrum bars, waveforms, bass-reactive effects), load the [./rules/audio-visualization.md](./rules/audio-visualization.md) file for more information.

## Sound effects

When needing to use sound effects, load the [./rules/sfx.md](./rules/sfx.md) file for more information.

## How to use

---
name: animations
description: Fundamental animation skills for Remotion
metadata:
  tags: animations, transitions, frames, useCurrentFrame
---

All animations MUST be driven by the `useCurrentFrame()` hook.  
Write animations in seconds and multiply them by the `fps` value from `useVideoConfig()`.

For eased motion, prefer `interpolate` with explicit frame ranges and an easing—especially `Easing.bezier`, which matches CSS `cubic-bezier` so timing can be shared with web specs and curve editors. See [timing](./timing.md).

```tsx
import { useCurrentFrame, Easing } from "remotion";

export const FadeIn = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const { fps } = useVideoConfig();

  const opacity = interpolate(frame, [0, 2 * fps], [0, 1], {
    extrapolateRight: "clamp",
    extrapolateLeft: "clamp",
    easing: Easing.bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
  });

  return <div style={{ opacity }}>Hello World!</div>;
};
```

CSS transitions or animations are FORBIDDEN - they will not render correctly.  
Tailwind animation class names are FORBIDDEN - they will not render correctly.

# Audio Visualization in Remotion

## Prerequisites

```bash
npx remotion add @remotion/media-utils
```

## Loading Audio Data

Use `useWindowedAudioData()` (https://www.remotion.dev/docs/use-windowed-audio-data) to load audio data:

```tsx
import { useWindowedAudioData } from "@remotion/media-utils";
import { staticFile, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig } from "remotion";

const frame = useCurrentFrame();
const { fps } = useVideoConfig();

const { audioData, dataOffsetInSeconds } = useWindowedAudioData({
  src: staticFile("podcast.wav"),
  frame,
  fps,
  windowInSeconds: 30,
});
```

## Spectrum Bar Visualization

Use `visualizeAudio()` (https://www.remotion.dev/docs/visualize-audio) to get frequency data for bar charts:

```tsx
import { useWindowedAudioData, visualizeAudio } from "@remotion/media-utils";
import { staticFile, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig } from "remotion";

const frame = useCurrentFrame();
const { fps } = useVideoConfig();

const { audioData, dataOffsetInSeconds } = useWindowedAudioData({
  src: staticFile("music.mp3"),
  frame,
  fps,
  windowInSeconds: 30,
});

if (!audioData) {
  return null;
}

const frequencies = visualizeAudio({
  fps,
  frame,
  audioData,
  numberOfSamples: 256,
  optimizeFor: "speed",
  dataOffsetInSeconds,
});

return (
  <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "flex-end", height: 200 }}>
    {frequencies.map((v, i) => (
      <div
        key={i}
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          height: `${v * 100}%`,
          backgroundColor: "#0b84f3",
          margin: "0 1px",
        }}
      />
    ))}
  </div>
);
```

- `numberOfSamples` must be power of 2 (32, 64, 128, <truncated omitted_approx_tokens="155" />othSvgPath,
  useWindowedAudioData,
  visualizeAudioWaveform,
} from "@remotion/media-utils";
import { staticFile, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig } from "remotion";

const frame = useCurrentFrame();
const { width, fps } = useVideoConfig();
const HEIGHT = 200;

const { audioData, dataOffsetInSeconds } = useWindowedAudioData({
  src: staticFile("voice.wav"),
  frame,
  fps,
  windowInSeconds: 30,
});

if (!audioData) {
  return null;
}

const waveform = visualizeAudioWaveform({
  fps,
  frame,
  audioData,
  numberOfSamples: 256,
  windowInSeconds: 0.5,
  dataOffsetInSeconds,
});

const path = createSmoothSvgPath({
  points: waveform.map((y, i) => ({
    x: (i / (waveform.length - 1)) * width,
    y: HEIGHT / 2 + (y * HEIGHT) / 2,
  })),
});

return (
  <svg width={width} height={HEIGHT}>
    <path d={path} fill="none" stroke="#0b84f3" strokeWidth={2} />
  </svg>
);
```

## Bass-Reactive Effects

Extract low frequencies for beat-reactive animations:

```tsx
const frequencies = visualizeAudio({
  fps,
  frame,
  audioData,
  numberOfSamples: 128,
  optimizeFor: "speed",
  dataOffsetInSeconds,
});

const lowFrequencies = frequencies.slice(0, 32);
const bassIntensity =
  lowFrequencies.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v, 0) / lowFrequencies.length;

const scale = 1 + bassIntensity * 0.5;
const opacity = Math.min(0.6, bassIntensity * 0.8);
```

## Volume-Based Waveform

Use `getWaveformPortion()` (https://www.remotion.dev/docs/get-waveform-portion) when you need simplified volume data instead of frequency spectrum:

```tsx
import { getWaveformPortion } from "@remotion/media-utils";
import { useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig } from "remotion";

const frame = useCurrentFrame();
const { fps } = useVideoConfig();
const currentTimeInSeconds = frame / fps;

const waveform = getWaveformPortion({
  audioData,
  startTimeInSeconds: currentTimeInSeconds,
  durationInSeconds: 5,
  numberOfSamples: 50,
});

// Returns array of { index, amplitude } objects (amplitude: 0-1)

---
name: remotion-best-practices
description: Best practices for Remotion - Video creation in React
metadata:
  tags: remotion, video, react, animation, composition
---

## When to use

Use this skills whenever you are dealing with Remotion code to obtain the domain-specific knowledge.

## New project setup

When in an empty folder or workspace with no existing Remotion project, scaffold one using:

```bash
npx create-video@latest --yes --blank --no-tailwind my-video
```

Replace `my-video` with a suitable project name.

## Starting preview

Start the Remotion Studio to preview a video:

```bash
npx remotion studio
```

## Optional: one-frame render check

You can render a single frame with the CLI to sanity-check layout, colors, or timing.  
Skip it for trivial edits, pure refactors, or when you already have enough confidence from Studio or prior renders.

```bash
npx remotion still [composition-id] --scale=0.25 --frame=30
```

At 30 fps, `--frame=30` is the one-second mark (`--frame` is zero-based).

## Captions

When dealing with captions or subtitles, load the [./rules/subtitles.md](./rules/subtitles.md) file for more information.

## Using FFmpeg

For some video operations, such as trimming videos or detecting silence, FFmpeg should be used. Load the [./rules/ffmpeg.md](./rules/ffmpeg.md) file for more information.

## Silence detection

When needing to detect and trim silent segments from video or audio files, load the [./rules/silence-detection.md](./rules/silence-detection.md) file.

## Audio visualization

When needing to visualize audio (spectrum bars, waveforms, bass-reactive effects), load the [./rules/audio-visualization.md](./rules/audio-visualization.md) file for more information.

## Sound effects

When needing to use sound effects, load the [./rules/sfx.md](./rules/sfx.md) file for more information.

## How to use

---
name: animations
description: Fundamental animation skills for Remotion
metadata:
  tags: animations, transitions, frames, useCurrentFrame
---

All animations MUST be driven by the `useCurrentFrame()` hook.  
Write animations in seconds and multiply them by the `fps` value from `useVideoConfig()`.

For eased motion, prefer `interpolate` with explicit frame ranges and an easing—especially `Easing.bezier`, which matches CSS `cubic-bezier` so timing can be shared with web specs and curve editors. See [timing](./timing.md).

```tsx
import { useCurrentFrame, Easing } from "remotion";

export const FadeIn = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const { fps } = useVideoConfig();

  const opacity = interpolate(frame, [0, 2 * fps], [0, 1], {
    extrapolateRight: "clamp",
    extrapolateLeft: "clamp",
    easing: Easing.bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
  });

  return <div style={{ opacity }}>Hello World!</div>;
};
```

CSS transitions or animations are FORBIDDEN - they will not render correctly.  
Tailwind animation class names are FORBIDDEN - they will not render correctly.

# Audio Visualization in Remotion

## Prerequisites

```bash
npx remotion add @remotion/media-utils
```

## Loading Audio Data

Use `useWindowedAudioData()` (https://www.remotion.dev/docs/use-windowed-audio-data) to load audio data:

```tsx
import { useWindowedAudioData } from "@remotion/media-utils";
import { staticFile, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig } from "remotion";

const frame = useCurrentFrame();
const { fps } = useVideoConfig();

const { audioData, dataOffsetInSeconds } = useWindowedAudioData({
  src: staticFile("podcast.wav"),
  frame,
  fps,
  windowInSeconds: 30,
});
```

## Spectrum Bar Visualization

Use `visualizeAudio()` (https://www.remotion.dev/docs/visualize-audio) to get frequency data for bar charts:

```tsx
import { useWindowedAudioData, visualizeAudio } from "@remotion/media-utils";
import { staticFile, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig } from "remotion";

const frame = useCurrentFrame();
const { fps } = useVideoConfig();

const { audioData, dataOffsetInSeconds } = useWindowedAudioData({
  src: staticFile("music.mp3"),
  frame,
  fps,
  windowInSeconds: 30,
});

if (!audioData) {
  return null;
}

const frequencies = visualizeAudio({
  fps,
  frame,
  audioData,
  numberOfSamples: 256,
  optimizeFor: "speed",
  dataOffsetInSeconds,
});

return (
  <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "flex-end", height: 200 }}>
    {frequencies.map((v, i) => (
      <div
        key={i}
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          height: `${v * 100}%`,
          backgroundColor: "#0b84f3",
          margin: "0 1px",
        }}
      />
    ))}
  </div>
);
```

- `numberOfSamples` must be power of 2 (32, 64, 128, <truncated omitted_approx_tokens="155" />othSvgPath,
  useWindowedAudioData,
  visualizeAudioWaveform,
} from "@remotion/media-utils";
import { staticFile, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig } from "remotion";

const frame = useCurrentFrame();
const { width, fps } = useVideoConfig();
const HEIGHT = 200;

const { audioData, dataOffsetInSeconds } = useWindowedAudioData({
  src: staticFile("voice.wav"),
  frame,
  fps,
  windowInSeconds: 30,
});

if (!audioData) {
  return null;
}

const waveform = visualizeAudioWaveform({
  fps,
  frame,
  audioData,
  numberOfSamples: 256,
  windowInSeconds: 0.5,
  dataOffsetInSeconds,
});

const path = createSmoothSvgPath({
  points: waveform.map((y, i) => ({
    x: (i / (waveform.length - 1)) * width,
    y: HEIGHT / 2 + (y * HEIGHT) / 2,
  })),
});

return (
  <svg width={width} height={HEIGHT}>
    <path d={path} fill="none" stroke="#0b84f3" strokeWidth={2} />
  </svg>
);
```

## Bass-Reactive Effects

Extract low frequencies for beat-reactive animations:

```tsx
const frequencies = visualizeAudio({
  fps,
  frame,
  audioData,
  numberOfSamples: 128,
  optimizeFor: "speed",
  dataOffsetInSeconds,
});

const lowFrequencies = frequencies.slice(0, 32);
const bassIntensity =
  lowFrequencies.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v, 0) / lowFrequencies.length;

const scale = 1 + bassIntensity * 0.5;
const opacity = Math.min(0.6, bassIntensity * 0.8);
```

## Volume-Based Waveform

Use `getWaveformPortion()` (https://www.remotion.dev/docs/get-waveform-portion) when you need simplified volume data instead of frequency spectrum:

```tsx
import { getWaveformPortion } from "@remotion/media-utils";
import { useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig } from "remotion";

const frame = useCurrentFrame();
const { fps } = useVideoConfig();
const currentTimeInSeconds = frame / fps;

const waveform = getWaveformPortion({
  audioData,
  startTimeInSeconds: currentTimeInSeconds,
  durationInSeconds: 5,
  numberOfSamples: 50,
});

// Returns array of { index, amplitude } objects (amplitude: 0-1)

+import fs from "node:fs";

+const rootDir = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..");
+const outputDir = path.join(rootDir, "android/app/src/main/assets/seed_music");
+const manifestPath = path.join(outputDir, "manifest.json");
+const endpoint = "https://api.minimax.io/v1/music_generation";
+const model = "music-2.6";
+
+function readProperties(filePath) {
+  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return {};
+  return Object.fromEntries(
+    fs
+      .readFileSync(filePath, "utf8")
+      .split(/\r?\n/)
+      .map((line) => line.trim())
+      .filter((line) => line && !line.startsWith("#") && line.includes("="))
+      .map((line) => {
+        const index = line.indexOf("=");
+        return [line.slice(0, index).trim(), line.slice(index + 1).trim()];
+      }),
+  );
+}
+
+function apiKey() {
+  const envKey = process.env.MINIMAX_API_KEY?.trim();
+  if (envKey) return envKey;
+  const localEnv = readProperties(path.join(rootDir, ".env.local")).MINIMAX_API_KEY;
+  if (localEnv) return localEnv;
+  const secrets = readProperties(path.join(rootDir, "android/secrets.properties")).MINIMAX_API_KEY;
+  if (secrets) return secrets;
+  throw new Error("MINIMAX_API_KEY is missing.");
+}

            setOnPreparedListener {

            setOnCompletionListener {

---
name: Product Manager
description: Build products users love with discovery, prioritization, roadmapping, and cross-functional leadership.
metadata: {"clawdbot":{"emoji":"🎯","os":["linux","darwin","win32"]}}

# Product Management Rules

## Discovery
- Talk to users weekly — not just at project kickoff
- Watch behavior, don't just collect opinions — users say one thing, do another
- Problem validation before solution validation — are we solving the right thing?
- Jobs to be done: what's the user trying to accomplish?
- Competitors show what's possible, not what to copy

## Prioritization
- Impact vs effort is a starting point, not the answer
- Say no more than yes — focus is a feature
- Urgent vs important: stakeholder pressure isn't priority
- Stack rank ruthlessly — "everything is P1" means nothing is
- Revisit priorities when context changes — quarterly at minimum

## Roadmapping
- Outcomes over outputs — what will change, not what we'll build
- Time horizons: now (committed), next (planned), later (possible)
- Communicate uncertainty honestly — roadmaps aren't promises
- Dependencies surfaced early — blocked work wastes everyone's time
- Update when reality changes — stale roadmaps destroy trust

## Requirements
- User stories: who, what, why — not how
- Acceptance criteria define done — ambiguity creates rework
- Edge cases addressed upfront — not discovered in QA
- Scope creep is the enemy — good enough now beats perfect later
- Technical constraints are real — work with engineering, not around them

## Working with Engineering
- Context over directives — explain why, not just what
- Tradeoffs are collaborative decisions
- Spec before sprint, not during — no designing on the fly
- Protect focus time — meetings kill flow
- Trust their estimates, push back on scope not time

## Working with Design
- Research together, don't hand off briefs
- Critique the work, not the designer
- Design reviews with users, not just stakeholders
- Mobile and edge cases early — not afterthoughts
- Design system enables speed — support it

## Stakeholder Management
- Regular updates prevent surprise requests
- Data calms opinion battles
- Explain trade-offs, don't just defend decisions
- Feedback channels prevent end-runs — make input easy
- Executive sponsors for big initiatives

## Metrics
- One north star metric, 2-3 supporting
- Leading indicators for early signal — don't wait for lagging
- Dashboards should prompt questions, not just display numbers
- Vanity metrics feel good, don't drive decisions
- A/B test when data beats intuition

## Launch
- Soft launch catches problems before scale
- Success criteria defined before launch — not after
- Rollback plan before rollout
- Cross-functional checklist: docs, support, marketing
- Post-launch review: what worked, what didn't

## Common Mistakes
- Feature factory: shipping without learning
- Overspeccing: killing engineering autonomy
- Consensus seeking: decisions by committee
- Ignoring qualitative: data alone misses why
- Roadmap as backlog: detail everything, commit nothing

[1034] assistant: 按 Product Manager skill 的发布框架看，MusePlay 现在更像“可体验原型”，离“可上架给终端客户”的产品还差几类关键补齐。结论先说：**最优先补的是账号/安全、AI 内容合规、付费成本控制、生成失败体验、隐私与上架材料**。

**P0 上架前必须补**
1. **不要在 APK 内置 API key**
   终端客户版本必须改成后端代理调用 MiniMax，不能让 Android 客户端直接带 key。现在 debug 版为了测试方便可以用本地 key，但上架版必须：App → 自家后端 → MiniMax。

2. **用户账号与额度系统**
   需要登录、游客模式、生成额度、每日限制、失败返还额度。否则生成音乐成本无法控制，10 个重度用户就可能烧穿 API 预算。

3. **AI 内容安全与举报**
   Google Play 的 AI 生成内容政策要求生成式 AI app 要防止生成违规内容，并提供 app 内举报/标记入口。MusePlay 至少要加：
   - 生成结果举报
   - 不当 prompt 拦截
   - 违规歌词/仿冒真人/色情暴力/仇恨内容过滤
   - 用户反馈进入后台审核队列

4. **隐私政策与数据安全披露**
   Google Play 要求所有 app 提交隐私政策，并在 Play Console 填 Data safety。MusePlay 要明确：
   - 收集哪些数据：prompt、歌词、生成结果、聊天记录、设备信息、支付信息
   - 数据是否分享给第三方 AI 服务
   - 数据保留多久
   - 用户如何删除数据

5. **AAB 正式发布包**
   Google Play 新应用通常应使用 Android App Bundle，而不是只上传 APK。当前项目能打 debug APK，但上架还需要：
   - release build type
   - 签名配置
   - `assembleRelease` / `bundleRelease`
   - ProGuard/R8 策略
   - 版本号管理

6. **目标 SDK 已符合但要保持**
   当前项目 targetSdk 是 35，符合 Google Play 2025 年 8 月 31 日后新应用 Android 15/API 35 要求。这个是好消息。

**P1 产品体验必须补**
1. **首次进入体验**
   现在打开就是 Feed，用户不一定知道这是 AI 音乐 app。建议 3 步 onboarding：
   - 选择心情/场景
   - 听一首推荐
   - 一键生成自己的第一首

2. **生成任务队列**
   生成音乐不是即时能力，必须有任务队列：
   - 正在生成
   - 生成成功
   - 生成失败可重试
   - 后台继续生成
   - 推送或站内通知

3. **Library 真正产品化**
   现在 Library 只是存曲。应补：
   - 按 Song / Instrumental / 收藏 / 最近生成筛选
   - 搜索
   - 删除
   - 重命名
   - 下载到本机
   - 生成相似版本

4. **成本可见但不暴露模型**
   不展示 MiniMax，但要展示用户侧成本感知：剩余额度、预计生成时间、失败是否扣额度。

5. **播放可靠性**
   你已经多次遇到 Mac mini/模拟器无声。终端客户必须有：
   - 播放失败提示
   - 音频路由提示
   - 文件损坏自动跳过
   - 音量状态可见
   - 后台播放/锁屏控制，至少 Android media session

**P1 商业化必须补**
1. **订阅/充值体系**
   建议 MVP：
   - 免费每日 3 次
   - 月订阅：每天 N 次
   - 点数包：按首生成
   - 高质量/长歌作为高级权益

2. **成本风控**
   后端必须做：
   - 用户级 rate limit
   - IP/device 风控
   - 失败重试上限
   - 黑名单 prompt
   - 异常消费报警

3. **支付合规**
   Android 上架数字内容通常要走 Google Play Billing，不能随便外链支付。

**P2 增长与留存**
1. **分享能力**
   音乐 app 没分享会很难增长。建议：
   - 分享试听页
   - 生成封面图
   - 导出短视频卡片
   - 分享到 TikTok/Instagram/微信

2. **Mood Agent 要闭环**
   Mood 不是聊天页，而应该是核心入口：
   用户说心情 → Agent 生成 3 个音乐方向 → 一键生成 → Feed 听 → Remix。

3. **推荐系统**
   当前 Feed 是本地列表。后续要按用户行为推荐：
   - 收藏
   - 完播
   - 跳过
   - 生成风格
   - 情绪偏好

**上架材料清单**
- App 名称、短描述、长描述
- 隐私政策 URL
- Terms of Service
- AI 内容免责声明
- 举报/反馈入口
- 应用图标、feature graphic、截图
- App Bundle `.aab`
- Release 签名
- Play Console Data safety
- 内容分级问卷
- 测试账号
- 后端 API 域名与稳定性监控

**我建议的上架路线**
Now：后端代理、账号额度、隐私政策、举报、release AAB。  
Next：生成队列、Library 管理、后台播放、支付订阅。  
Later：社交分享、推荐系统、Mood Agent 深度个性化。

[Google Play User Data / Privacy Policy](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/10144311?hl=en)

[1035] user: 从用户体验角度分析目前app功能有哪些需要改进


[1036] assistant: 从用户体验看，MusePlay 现在最需要解决的是：**让用户更快听到“属于自己”的音乐，并且知道下一步该做什么。**

**核心体验问题**
1. **入口不够清晰**
打开就是 Feed，但用户不一定知道自己可以“用情绪生成音乐”。建议首次进入直接给 3 个入口：
- 我现在的心情
- 我要一首歌
- 给我随机推荐

2. **Mood 没有成为核心**
Mood 现在像聊天页，但它应该是超级音乐 app 的灵魂。建议改成：
用户说一句心情 → Agent 给 3 个音乐方向 → 一键生成 → 自动进入 Feed 播放。

3. **Create 成本太高**
用户要理解 title、prompt、Song/Instrumental、歌词，这对普通用户太复杂。建议：
- 默认只保留一句话输入
- 高级参数收进“更多”
- 提供 mood chips：治愈、专注、跑步、失恋、睡前

4. **生成过程还不够可信**
已有进度条，但用户还不知道“卡没卡住”。建议分阶段：
- 理解你的情绪
- 写旋律
- 编曲
- 保存到本地
- 完成，点击播放

5. **播放页缺少“下一步动作”**
现在 Feed 好看了，但听完之后用户能做的少。建议在标题附近加：
- 再生成类似
- 换一种风格
- 保存到歌单
- 分享

6. **Library 像仓库，不像个人音乐空间**
建议分区：
- 我的生成
- 我的收藏
- 最近听过
- 心情历史
- 苏东坡/古风/跑步/睡眠等自动分类

7. **随机播放反馈不明显**
虽然逻辑修了，但用户不知道当前模式。建议切换时右侧弹出：
`随机播放已开启`，并在顶部小字显示当前模式。

8. **音频问题需要产品化处理**
用户遇到没声音时，现在只能猜。建议加：
- 播放失败提示
- 当前音量显示
- “检查声音”按钮
- 无声时提示：请检查系统音量/蓝牙/模拟器音频

9. **动画很美，但与音乐关系还不够强**
背景动画应跟播放状态、风格、节奏更强绑定：
- 古风：水墨/宣纸/流云
- 电子：光带/粒子
- 钢琴：柔光/波纹
- 暂停时明显静下来

10. **缺少成就感**
生成成功后只是进入曲库。建议给用户一个“作品完成”的仪式感：
封面、标题、风格标签、播放按钮、收藏、分享。

**优先级建议**
P0：简化 Create、强化 Mood 到生成闭环、无声/失败提示。  
P1：Library 分类、生成类似、分享、播放模式可见。  
P2：个性化推荐、歌单、社交、用户画像。

一句话：现在 app 已经“能生成和播放”，下一步要变成“用户说出情绪，马上听到回应”。

---
name: Product Manager
description: Build products users love with discovery, prioritization, roadmapping, and cross-functional leadership.
metadata: {"clawdbot":{"emoji":"🎯","os":["linux","darwin","win32"]}}

# Product Management Rules

## Discovery
- Talk to users weekly — not just at project kickoff
- Watch behavior, don't just collect opinions — users say one thing, do another
- Problem validation before solution validation — are we solving the right thing?
- Jobs to be done: what's the user trying to accomplish?
- Competitors show what's possible, not what to copy

## Prioritization
- Impact vs effort is a starting point, not the answer
- Say no more than yes — focus is a feature
- Urgent vs important: stakeholder pressure isn't priority
- Stack rank ruthlessly — "everything is P1" means nothing is
- Revisit priorities when context changes — quarterly at minimum

## Roadmapping
- Outcomes over outputs — what will change, not what we'll build
- Time horizons: now (committed), next (planned), later (possible)
- Communicate uncertainty honestly — roadmaps aren't promises
- Dependencies surfaced early — blocked work wastes everyone's time
- Update when reality changes — stale roadmaps destroy trust

## Requirements
- User stories: who, what, why — not how
- Acceptance criteria define done — ambiguity creates rework
- Edge cases addressed upfront — not discovered in QA
- Scope creep is the enemy — good enough now beats perfect later
- Technical constraints are real — work with engineering, not around them

## Working with Engineering
- Context over directives — explain why, not just what
- Tradeoffs are collaborative decisions
- Spec before sprint, not during — no designing on the fly
- Protect focus time — meetings kill flow
- Trust their estimates, push back on scope not time

## Working with Design
- Research together, don't hand off briefs
- Critique the work, not the designer
- Design reviews with users, not just stakeholders
- Mobile and edge cases early — not afterthoughts
- Design system enables speed — support it

## Stakeholder Management
- Regular updates prevent surprise requests
- Data calms opinion battles
- Explain trade-offs, don't just defend decisions
- Feedback channels prevent end-runs — make input easy
- Executive sponsors for big initiatives

## Metrics
- One north star metric, 2-3 supporting
- Leading indicators for early signal — don't wait for lagging
- Dashboards should prompt questions, not just display numbers
- Vanity metrics feel good, don't drive decisions
- A/B test when data beats intuition

## Launch
- Soft launch catches problems before scale
- Success criteria defined before launch — not after
- Rollback plan before rollout
- Cross-functional checklist: docs, support, marketing
- Post-launch review: what worked, what didn't

## Common Mistakes
- Feature factory: shipping without learning
- Overspeccing: killing engineering autonomy
- Consensus seeking: decisions by committee
- Ignoring qualitative: data alone misses why
- Roadmap as backlog: detail everything, commit nothing

**P0 上架前必须补**
1. **不要在 APK 内置 API key**
   终端客户版本必须改成后端代理调用 MiniMax，不能让 Android 客户端直接带 key。现在 debug 版为了测试方便可以用本地 key，但上架版必须：App → 自家后端 → MiniMax。

2. **用户账号与额度系统**
   需要登录、游客模式、生成额度、每日限制、失败返还额度。否则生成音乐成本无法控制，10 个重度用户就可能烧穿 API 预算。

3. **AI 内容安全与举报**
   Google Play 的 AI 生成内容政策要求生成式 AI app 要防止生成违规内容，并提供 app 内举报/标记入口。MusePlay 至少要加：
   - 生成结果举报
   - 不当 prompt 拦截
   - 违规歌词/仿冒真人/色情暴力/仇恨内容过滤
   - 用户反馈进入后台审核队列

4. **隐私政策与数据安全披露**
   Google Play 要求所有 app 提交隐私政策，并在 Play Console 填 Data safety。MusePlay 要明确：
   - 收集哪些数据：prompt、歌词、生成结果、聊天记录、设备信息、支付信息
   - 数据是否分享给第三方 AI 服务
   - 数据保留多久
   - 用户如何删除数据

   Google Play 新应用通常应使用 Android App Bundle，而不是只上传 APK。当前项目能打 debug APK，但上架还需要：

- 理解你的情绪
- 写旋律
- 编曲
- 保存到本地
- 完成，点击播放

5. **播放页缺少“下一步动作”**
现在 Feed 好看了，但听完之后用户能做的少。建议在标题附近加：
- 再生成类似
- 换一种风格
- 保存到歌单
- 分享

6. **Library 像仓库，不像个人音乐空间**
建议分区：
- 我的生成
- 我的收藏
- 最近听过
- 心情历史
- 苏东坡/古风/跑步/睡眠等自动分类

7. **随机播放反馈不明显**
虽然逻辑修了，但用户不知道当前模式。建议切换时右侧弹出：
`随机播放已开启`，并在顶部小字显示当前模式。

8. **音频问题需要产品化处理**
用户遇到没声音时，现在只能猜。建议加：
- 播放失败提示
- 当前音量显示
- “检查声音”按钮
- 无声时提示：请检查系统音量/蓝牙/模拟器音频

9. **动画很美，但与音乐关系还不够强**
背景动画应跟播放状态、风格、节奏更强绑定：
- 古风：水墨/宣纸/流云
- 电子：光带/粒子
- 钢琴：柔光/波纹
- 暂停时明显静下来

10. **缺少成就感**
生成成功后只是进入曲库。建议给用户一个“作品完成”的仪式感：
封面、标题、风格标签、播放按钮、收藏、分享。

**优先级建议**
P0：简化 Create、强化 Mood 到生成闭环、无声/失败提示。  
P1：Library 分类、生成类似、分享、播放模式可见。  
P2：个性化推荐、歌单、社交、用户画像。

一句话：现在 app 已经“能生成和播放”，下一步要变成“用户说出情绪，马上听到回应”。

1. **入口更简单**
   打开后直接让用户选择心情/场景，而不是先看 Feed。

2. **Mood 做成核心**
   用户说一句心情 → Agent 推荐方向 → 一键生成音乐。

3. **Create 简化**
   普通用户只输入一句话，高级 prompt/歌词放到二级设置。

4. **生成过程更明确**
   显示阶段：理解情绪、编曲、生成、保存、完成。

5. **播放页加下一步动作**
   增加：生成类似、换风格、收藏、分享。

6. **Library 分类**
   按收藏、生成、最近播放、心情历史、风格分类。

7. **声音问题要有提示**
   无声/播放失败时给用户明确检查入口。

8. **动画更贴合音乐**
   不同风格匹配不同背景动画，暂停时变静，播放时更活跃。

import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const rootDir = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..");
const promptBankPath = path.join(rootDir, "android/app/src/main/assets/prompt_bank.json");
const outputDir = path.join(rootDir, "android/app/src/main/assets/seed_music");

const endpoint = "https://api.minimax.io/v1/music_generation";

function readProperties(filePath) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return {};
  return Object.fromEntries(
    fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8")
      .split(/\r?\n/)
      .map((line) => line.trim())
      .filter((line) => line && !line.startsWith("#") && line.includes("="))
      .map((line) => {
        const index = line.indexOf("=");
        return [line.slice(0, index).trim(), line.slice(index + 1).trim()];
      }),
  );
}

function apiKey() {
  return process.env.MINIMAX_API_KEY?.trim()
    || readProperties(path.join(rootDir, ".env.local")).MINIMAX_API_KEY

}

function slug(value) {
  return value.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "").slice(0, 58);
}

  if (!fs.existsSync(manifestPath)) return [];
  return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(manifestPath, "utf8"));
}

}

async function tryGenerate(item, successIndex, attempts = 3) {
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= attempts; attempt += 1) {

}

import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const rootDir = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..");
const promptBankPath = path.join(rootDir, "android/app/src/main/assets/prompt_bank.json");
const outputDir = path.join(rootDir, "android/app/src/main/assets/seed_music");
const manifestPath = path.join(outputDir, "manifest.json");

const totalSongs = Number.parseInt(process.argv[2] || "20", 10);
const totalInstrumentals = Number.parseInt(process.argv[3] || "20", 10);
const endpoint = "https://api.minimax.io/v1/music_generation";
const model = "music-2.6";

function readProperties(filePath) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return {};
  return Object.fromEntries(
    fs
      .readFileSync(filePath, "utf8")
      .split(/\r?\n/)
      .map((line) => line.trim())
      .filter((line) => line && !line.startsWith("#") && line.includes("="))
      .map((line) => {
        const index = line.indexOf("=");
        return [line.slice(0, index).trim(), line.slice(index + 1).trim()];
      }),
  );
}

function apiKey() {
  const envKey = process.env.MINIMAX_API_KEY?.trim();
  if (envKey) return envKey;
  const localEnv = readProperties(path.join(rootDir, ".env.local")).MINIMAX_API_KEY;
  if (localEnv) return localEnv;
  const secrets = readProperties(path.join(rootDir, "android/secrets.properties")).MINIMAX_API_KEY;
  if (secrets) return secrets;
  throw new Error("MINIMAX_API_KEY is missing.");
}

function slug(value) {
  return value
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "")
    .slice(0, 64);
}

function batchFileName(item, mode, index) {
  const prefix = mode === "Song" ? "song" : "instrumental";
  return `batch-${prefix}-${String(index).padStart(2, "0")}-${slug(item.title)}.mp3`;
}

    writeManifest(manifest);

  const songCount = manifest.filter((entry) => entry.mode === "Song").length;
  const instrumentalCount = manifest.filter((entry) => entry.mode === "Instrumental").length;

package com.museplay.android

import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import java.util.UUID

enum class FlashTab(val label: String) {
    Home("Listen"),
    Create("Create"),
    Agent("Mood"),
    Me("Library")
}

enum class MusicMode(
    val label: String,
    val isInstrumental: Boolean
) {
    Instrumental("Instrumental", true),
    Song("Song", false)
}

enum class PlaybackMode(
    val label: String,
    val icon: String
) {
    Sequential("Sequential", "→"),
    Shuffle("Shuffle", "⤨"),
    RepeatOne("Repeat one", "↻");

    fun next(): PlaybackMode = when (this) {
        Sequential -> Shuffle
        Shuffle -> RepeatOne
        RepeatOne -> Sequential
    }
}

data class MusicPalette(
    val accent: Color,
    val primary: Color,
    val secondary: Color
)

data class MusicTrack(
    val id: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
    val title: String,
    val summary: String,
    val prompt: String,
    val audioUrl: String,
    val localPath: String,
    val durationMs: Long?,
    val mode: MusicMode,
    val palette: MusicPalette,
    val creator: String,
    val isGenerated: Boolean = false,
    val isFavorite: Boolean = false
)

data class GeneratedMusic(
    val title: String,
    val summary: String,
    val prompt: String,
    val audioUrl: String,
    val localPath: String,
    val durationMs: Long?,
    val mode: MusicMode,
    val model: String
)

data class AgentMessage(
    val text: String,
    val fromUser: Boolean,
    val mood: String = "Neutral",
    val expression: String = "calm",
    val createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
)

data class MusicRecommendation(
    val title: String,
    val mood: String,
    val prompt: String
)

data class PromptSeed(
    val title: String,
    val prompt: String,
    val mode: MusicMode = MusicMode.Instrumental
)

data class EmotionInsight(
    val mood: Strin<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="166" />F))
    )
}

object SampleMusic {
    fun feed(): List<MusicTrack> = emptyList()
}

fun MusicTrack.toJson(): org.json.JSONObject = org.json.JSONObject().apply {
    put("id", id)
    put("title", title)
    put("summary", summary)
    put("prompt", prompt)
    put("audioUrl", audioUrl)
    put("localPath", localPath)
    put("durationMs", durationMs ?: org.json.JSONObject.NULL)
    put("mode", mode.name)
    put("creator", creator)
    put("isGenerated", isGenerated)
    put("isFavorite", isFavorite)
}

fun AgentMessage.toJson(): org.json.JSONObject = org.json.JSONObject().apply {
    put("text", text)
    put("fromUser", fromUser)
    put("mood", mood)
    put("expression", expression)
    put("createdAt", createdAt)
}

fun agentMessageFromJson(json: org.json.JSONObject): AgentMessage {
    return AgentMessage(
        text = json.optString("text"),
        fromUser = json.optBoolean("fromUser"),
        mood = json.optString("mood", "Neutral"),
        expression = json.optString("expression", "calm"),
        createdAt = json.optLong("createdAt", System.currentTimeMillis())
    )
}

fun musicTrackFromJson(json: org.json.JSONObject, palette: MusicPalette): MusicTrack {
    return MusicTrack(
        id = json.optString("id").ifBlank { UUID.randomUUID().toString() },
        title = json.optString("title", "Generated Track"),
        summary = json.optString("summary", "Generated and saved locally."),
        prompt = json.optString("prompt"),
        audioUrl = json.optString("audioUrl"),
        localPath = json.optString("localPath"),
        durationMs = json.optLong("durationMs").takeIf { !json.isNull("durationMs") && it > 0 },
        mode = runCatching { MusicMode.valueOf(json.optString("mode")) }.getOrDefault(MusicMode.Instrumental),
        palette = palette,
        creator = json.optString("creator", "Local"),
        isGenerated = json.optBoolean("isGenerated", true),
        isFavorite = json.optBoolean("isFavorite", false)
    )
}

package com.museplay.android

import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import java.util.UUID

enum class FlashTab(val label: String) {
    Home("Listen"),
    Create("Create"),
    Agent("Mood"),
    Me("Library")
}

enum class MusicMode(
    val label: String,
    val isInstrumental: Boolean
) {
    Instrumental("Instrumental", true),
    Song("Song", false)
}

enum class PlaybackMode(
    val label: String,
    val icon: String
) {
    Sequential("Sequential", "→"),
    Shuffle("Shuffle", "⤨"),
    RepeatOne("Repeat one", "↻");

    fun next(): PlaybackMode = when (this) {
        Sequential -> Shuffle
        Shuffle -> RepeatOne
        RepeatOne -> Sequential
    }
}

data class MusicPalette(
    val accent: Color,
    val primary: Color,
    val secondary: Color
)

data class MusicTrack(
    val id: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
    val title: String,
    val summary: String,
    val prompt: String,
    val audioUrl: String,
    val localPath: String,
    val durationMs: Long?,
    val mode: MusicMode,
    val palette: MusicPalette,
    val creator: String,
    val isGenerated: Boolean = false,
    val isFavorite: Boolean = false
)

data class GeneratedMusic(
    val title: String,
    val summary: String,
    val prompt: String,
    val audioUrl: String,
    val localPath: String,
    val durationMs: Long?,
    val mode: MusicMode,
    val model: String
)

data class AgentMessage(
    val text: String,
    val fromUser: Boolean,
    val mood: String = "Neutral",
    val expression: String = "calm",
    val createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
)

data class MusicRecommendation(
    val title: String,
    val mood: String,
    val prompt: String
)

data class PromptSeed(
    val title: String,
    val prompt: String,
    val mode: MusicMode = MusicMode.Instrumental
)

data class EmotionInsight(
    val mood: Strin<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="166" />F))
    )
}

object SampleMusic {
    fun feed(): List<MusicTrack> = emptyList()
}

fun MusicTrack.toJson(): org.json.JSONObject = org.json.JSONObject().apply {
    put("id", id)
    put("title", title)
    put("summary", summary)
    put("prompt", prompt)
    put("audioUrl", audioUrl)
    put("localPath", localPath)
    put("durationMs", durationMs ?: org.json.JSONObject.NULL)
    put("mode", mode.name)
    put("creator", creator)
    put("isGenerated", isGenerated)
    put("isFavorite", isFavorite)
}

fun AgentMessage.toJson(): org.json.JSONObject = org.json.JSONObject().apply {
    put("text", text)
    put("fromUser", fromUser)
    put("mood", mood)
    put("expression", expression)
    put("createdAt", createdAt)
}

fun agentMessageFromJson(json: org.json.JSONObject): AgentMessage {
    return AgentMessage(
        text = json.optString("text"),
        fromUser = json.optBoolean("fromUser"),
        mood = json.optString("mood", "Neutral"),
        expression = json.optString("expression", "calm"),
        createdAt = json.optLong("createdAt", System.currentTimeMillis())
    )
}

fun musicTrackFromJson(json: org.json.JSONObject, palette: MusicPalette): MusicTrack {
    return MusicTrack(
        id = json.optString("id").ifBlank { UUID.randomUUID().toString() },
        title = json.optString("title", "Generated Track"),
        summary = json.optString("summary", "Generated and saved locally."),
        prompt = json.optString("prompt"),
        audioUrl = json.optString("audioUrl"),
        localPath = json.optString("localPath"),
        durationMs = json.optLong("durationMs").takeIf { !json.isNull("durationMs") && it > 0 },
        mode = runCatching { MusicMode.valueOf(json.optString("mode")) }.getOrDefault(MusicMode.Instrumental),
        palette = palette,
        creator = json.optString("creator", "Local"),
        isGenerated = json.optBoolean("isGenerated", true),
        isFavorite = json.optBoolean("isFavorite", false)
    )
}

@Composable
private fun ListenScreen(
    dailyVibe: String,
    tracks: List<MusicTrack>,
    activeTrackId: String?,
    playbackError: String?,
    playbackVolume: Float,
    playbackPositionMs: Long,
    playbackDurationMs: Long,
    playbackCompletionToken: Int,
    onPlay: (MusicTrack) -> Unit,
    onFavorite: (String) -> Unit,
    onVolumeChange: (Float) -> Unit
) {
    var currentIndex by remember(tracks.size) { mutableStateOf(0) }
    var dragTotal by remember { mutableStateOf(0f) }
    var showVolumePanel by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var favoriteNotice by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var favoritePulseId by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var playbackMode by remember { mutableStateOf(PlaybackMode.Sequential) }
    var modeNotice by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var selectedFeedMode by remember { mutableStateOf<MusicMode?>(null) }
    val visibleTracks = remember(tracks, selectedFeedMode) {
        selectedFeedMode?.let { mode -> tracks.filter { it.mode == mode } } ?: tracks
    }
    var shuffleBag by remember(visibleTracks.size, selectedFeedMode) { mutableStateOf(emptyList<Int>()) }
    currentIndex = currentIndex.coerceIn(0, (visibleTracks.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(0))
    val currentTrack = visibleTracks.getOrNull(currentIndex.coerceIn(0, (visibleTracks.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)))

    fun nextShuffleIndex(fromIndex: Int): Int {
        if (visibleTracks.size <= 1) return fromIndex
        val available = shuffleBag.filter { it in visibleTracks.indices && it != fromIndex }
            .ifEmpty { visibleTracks.indices.filter { it != fromIndex }.shuffled() }
        val next = available.first()
        shuffleBag = available.drop(1)
        return next
    }

    fun nextIndexForMode(fromIndex: Int): Int {
        return when (playbackMode) {
            PlaybackMode.Sequential -> (fromIndex + 1).coerceAtMost(visibleTracks.lastIndex)
            PlaybackMode.Shuffle -> nextShuffleIndex(fromIndex)
            PlaybackMode.RepeatOne -> fromIndex
        }
    }

    fun previousIndexForMode(fromIndex: Int): Int {
        return when (playbackMode) {
            PlaybackMode.Sequential -> (fromIndex - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)
            PlaybackMode.Shuffle -> nextShuffleIndex(fromIndex)
            PlaybackMode.RepeatOne -> fromIndex

private fun MusicTrack.durationLabel(): String {
    val seconds = durationMs?.div(1000) ?: return "ready"
    val minutes = seconds / 60
    val rest = seconds % 60
    return if (minutes > 0) "${minutes}m ${rest}s" else "${rest}s"
}

private fun MusicTrack.durationLabel(): String {
    val seconds = durationMs?.div(1000) ?: return "ready"
    val minutes = seconds / 60
    val rest = seconds % 60
    return if (minutes > 0) "${minutes}m ${rest}s" else "${rest}s"
}

[425] assistant: 原因已经查到了：**不是 app 停播，也不是 Mac 音量问题，是 Android 模拟器的音频桥接层卡住了。**

我刚看日志，当前 app 仍然在 Android 里正常播放：

- `MediaPlayer state: started`
- `STREAM_MUSIC` 音量 `15/15`
- 未静音
- 当前曲目是 `Glass City Sprint`

但模拟器底层一直报：

```text
android.hardware.audio@7.1-impl.ranchu: pcm_writei failed
cannot read/write stream data: I/O error
```

这句话的意思是：**Android 已经把 PCM 音频写给模拟器音频设备了，但模拟器的 ranchu 音频层写不到 Mac 宿主机输出设备**。所以界面和 Android 播放状态都显示“正在播放”，但 Mac 没声音。

为什么是“播放几首后”才出现：现在 feed 流切歌会频繁创建/释放 `MediaPlayer`，模拟器音频 HAL 有时会在多次切歌后卡住。真机上通常不会这样，主要是模拟器音频桥的问题。

解决方向：
1. 临时恢复：冷重启模拟器，音频桥会恢复。
2. App 优化：把播放内核从频繁重建 `MediaPlayer` 改成更稳定的播放队列/单播放器模式，最好换成 ExoPlayer，减少模拟器音频层被反复 reset 的概率。

fun quote(value: String): String = "\"" + value

fun secret(name: String): String {

    val env = providers.environmentVariable(name).orNull
    if (!env.isNullOrBlank()) return env
    val localSecret = secretProperties.getProperty(name)
    if (!localSecret.isNullOrBlank()) return localSecret
    return localProperties.getProperty(name, "")

[425] assistant: 原因已经查到了：**不是 app 停播，也不是 Mac 音量问题，是 Android 模拟器的音频桥接层卡住了。**

我刚看日志，当前 app 仍然在 Android 里正常播放：

- `MediaPlayer state: started`
- `STREAM_MUSIC` 音量 `15/15`
- 未静音
- 当前曲目是 `Glass City Sprint`

但模拟器底层一直报：

```text
android.hardware.audio@7.1-impl.ranchu: pcm_writei failed
cannot read/write stream data: I/O error
```

这句话的意思是：**Android 已经把 PCM 音频写给模拟器音频设备了，但模拟器的 ranchu 音频层写不到 Mac 宿主机输出设备**。所以界面和 Android 播放状态都显示“正在播放”，但 Mac 没声音。

为什么是“播放几首后”才出现：现在 feed 流切歌会频繁创建/释放 `MediaPlayer`，模拟器音频 HAL 有时会在多次切歌后卡住。真机上通常不会这样，主要是模拟器音频桥的问题。

解决方向：
1. 临时恢复：冷重启模拟器，音频桥会恢复。
2. App 优化：把播放内核从频繁重建 `MediaPlayer` 改成更稳定的播放队列/单播放器模式，最好换成 ExoPlayer，减少模拟器音频层被反复 reset 的概率。

---
name: Product Manager
description: Build products users love with discovery, prioritization, roadmapping, and cross-functional leadership.
metadata: {"clawdbot":{"emoji":"🎯","os":["linux","darwin","win32"]}}
---

# Product Management Rules

## Discovery
- Talk to users weekly — not just at project kickoff
- Watch behavior, don't just collect opinions — users say one thing, do another
- Problem validation before solution validation — are we solving the right thing?
- Jobs to be done: what's the user trying to accomplish?
- Competitors show what's possible, not what to copy

## Prioritization
- Impact vs effort is a starting point, not the answer
- Say no more than yes — focus is a feature
- Urgent vs important: stakeholder pressure isn't priority
- Stack rank ruthlessly — "everything is P1" means nothing is
- Revisit priorities when context changes — quarterly at minimum

## Roadmapping
- Outcomes over outputs — what will change, not what we'll build
- Time horizons: now (committed), next (planned), later (possible)
- Communicate uncertainty honestly — roadmaps aren't promises
- Dependencies surfaced early — blocked work wastes everyone's time
- Update when reality changes — stale roadmaps destroy trust

## Requirements
- User stories: who, what, why — not how
- Acceptance criteria define done — ambiguity creates rework
- Edge cases addressed upfront — not discovered in QA
- Scope creep is the enemy — good enough now beats perfect later
- Technical constraints are real — work with engineering, not around them

## Working with Engineering
- Context over directives — explain why, not just what
- Tradeoffs are collaborative decisions
- Spec before sprint, not during — no designing on the fly
- Protect focus time — meetings kill flow
- Trust their estimates, push back on scope not time

## Working with Design
- Research together, don't hand off briefs
- Critique the work, not the designer
- Design reviews with users, not just stakeholders
- Mobile and edge cases early — not afterthoughts
- Design system enables speed — support it

## Stakeholder Management
- Regular updates prevent surprise requests
- Data calms opinion battles
- Explain trade-offs, don't just defend decisions
- Feedback channels prevent end-runs — make input easy
- Executive sponsors for big initiatives

## Metrics
- One north star metric, 2-3 supporting
- Leading indicators for early signal — don't wait for lagging
- Dashboards should prompt questions, not just display numbers
- Vanity metrics feel good, don't drive decisions
- A/B test when data beats intuition

## Launch
- Soft launch catches problems before scale
- Success criteria defined before launch — not after
- Rollback plan before rollout
- Cross-functional checklist: docs, support, marketing
- Post-launch review: what worked, what didn't

## Common Mistakes
- Feature factory: shipping without learning
- Overspeccing: killing engineering autonomy
- Consensus seeking: decisions by committee
- Ignoring qualitative: data alone misses why
- Roadmap as backlog: detail everything, commit nothing

3. MuseCat 卡通角色
4. 对话历史
5. 输入框
6. `Reflect my mood` 按钮
7. 推荐音乐方向卡片，点击后跳到 `Create`

核心路径是：

`输入情绪 → 识别情绪 → Agent 回复 → 推荐 3 个音乐方向 → 点击 Use → 跳到 Create 生成音乐`

**主要问题**
1. 页面标题仍叫 `Music Agent`，但底部 Tab 是 `Mood`，命名不统一。建议页面标题也改成 `Mood` 或 `Muse Mood`。

2. 情绪洞察卡在用户输入前就出现，但默认内容偏功能说明，不够像“当前情绪状态”。建议初始态改成更明确的空状态，例如“Tell MuseCat how you feel”。

3. 对话历史位置太靠前。现在用户还没输入，就先看到历史模块，会打断核心任务。建议顺序改为：角色 → 输入 → 情绪洞察 → 推荐 → 历史。

4. `Reflect my mood` 只“分析”，但用户目标其实是“把情绪变成音乐”。按钮文案建议改成 `Turn mood into music` 或 `Create mood sound`。

5. 推荐卡点击后只是跳到 Create，没有在 Mood 页形成“立即试听/生成”的闭环。建议增加主按钮：`Generate this mood`，直接调用生成。

6. MuseCat 目前是视觉角色，但互动感不足。它会变化表情，但用户不知道为什么变。建议在角色旁显示一句动态短语，例如“Feels tender today”或“I hear calm energy”。

7. 情绪识别规则偏简单。当前主要靠关键词匹配，中文覆盖有限，容易误判。建议增加更多情绪维度：焦虑、孤独、怀念、治愈、兴奋、失眠、专注、释压。

**优先级建议**
P0：统一命名，把 `Music Agent` 改为 `Mood`，按钮改为更明确的音乐结果导向。  
P1：重排页面，把输入框和生成动作提前，让用户更快完成“情绪 → 音乐”。  
P1：推荐卡增加 `Generate`，减少跳转成本。  
P2：增强 MuseCat 的状态反馈，让它像真的在陪伴用户。  
P2：扩展情绪识别词库和标签体系。

**一句话结论**
Mood 页现在像“聊天分析页”，但产品目标应该是“情绪音乐入口”。下一步应把它改成更短路径的：**说出心情 → Agent 理解 → 一键生成/播放对应音乐**。

[545] user: 如何简化mood页面UI


[546] assistant: 可以把 Mood 页简化成一个核心动作：**说出心情，生成/推荐音乐**。

建议改成 4 个区块：

1. **顶部角色区**
   - 只保留 MuseCat + 一句状态文案  
   - 去掉大标题 `Music Agent`
   - 例如：`How are you feeling?`

2. **输入区**
   - 一个大输入框
   - 一个主按钮：`Turn mood into music`
   - 不要把“对话历史”放在输入前

3. **当前情绪卡**
   - 只显示 2 个标签：`Calm`、`Low energy`
   - 下面一句音乐方向：`Soft piano, ambient pads`
   - 去掉复杂说明文字

4. **推荐音乐方向**
   - 最多 3 张小卡
   - 每张只显示：标题、情绪、`Generate`
   - 不再显示长 prompt

可以移除或弱化：
- `Conversation history` 默认折叠
- 长说明文案
- 大量聊天气泡
- `Recommended directions` 大标题
- 过多卡片边框

最简布局：

```text
[MuseCat 表情]
How are you feeling?

[输入心情...]

[Turn mood into music]

Calm · Low energy
Soft piano, ambient pads

[Gentle Reset] [Generate]
[Deep Focus]   [Generate]
[Warm Lift]    [Generate]

History >
```

这样 Mood 会更像一个“情绪音乐入口”，而不是聊天页面。

---
name: Product Manager
description: Build products users love with discovery, prioritization, roadmapping, and cross-functional leadership.
metadata: {"clawdbot":{"emoji":"🎯","os":["linux","darwin","win32"]}}
---

# Product Management Rules

## Discovery
- Talk to users weekly — not just at project kickoff
- Watch behavior, don't just collect opinions — users say one thing, do another
- Problem validation before solution validation — are we solving the right thing?
- Jobs to be done: what's the user trying to accomplish?
- Competitors show what's possible, not what to copy

## Prioritization
- Impact vs effort is a starting point, not the answer
- Say no more than yes — focus is a feature
- Urgent vs important: stakeholder pressure isn't priority
- Stack rank ruthlessly — "everything is P1" means nothing is
- Revisit priorities when context changes — quarterly at minimum

## Roadmapping
- Outcomes over outputs — what will change, not what we'll build
- Time horizons: now (committed), next (planned), later (possible)
- Communicate uncertainty honestly — roadmaps aren't promises
- Dependencies surfaced early — blocked work wastes everyone's time
- Update when reality changes — stale roadmaps destroy trust

## Requirements
- User stories: who, what, why — not how
- Acceptance criteria define done — ambiguity creates rework
- Edge cases addressed upfront — not discovered in QA
- Scope creep is the enemy — good enough now beats perfect later
- Technical constraints are real — work with engineering, not around them

## Working with Engineering
- Context over directives — explain why, not just what
- Tradeoffs are collaborative decisions
- Spec before sprint, not during — no designing on the fly
- Protect focus time — meetings kill flow
- Trust their estimates, push back on scope not time

## Working with Design
- Research together, don't hand off briefs
- Critique the work, not the designer
- Design reviews with users, not just stakeholders
- Mobile and edge cases early — not afterthoughts
- Design system enables speed — support it

## Stakeholder Management
- Regular updates prevent surprise requests
- Data calms opinion battles
- Explain trade-offs, don't just defend decisions
- Feedback channels prevent end-runs — make input easy
- Executive sponsors for big initiatives

## Metrics
- One north star metric, 2-3 supporting
- Leading indicators for early signal — don't wait for lagging
- Dashboards should prompt questions, not just display numbers
- Vanity metrics feel good, don't drive decisions
- A/B test when data beats intuition

## Launch
- Soft launch catches problems before scale
- Success criteria defined before launch — not after
- Rollback plan before rollout
- Cross-functional checklist: docs, support, marketing
- Post-launch review: what worked, what didn't

## Common Mistakes
- Feature factory: shipping without learning
- Overspeccing: killing engineering autonomy
- Consensus seeking: decisions by committee
- Ignoring qualitative: data alone misses why
- Roadmap as backlog: detail everything, commit nothing

[544] assistant: 已调用 Product Manager skill 分析。Mood 页当前定位是：**用户把情绪说给音乐 Agent，Agent 识别情绪，再推荐可生成的音乐方向**。方向是对的，但交互闭环还不够强。

**当前交互逻辑**
用户进入 `Mood` 后，会看到：

1. `Music Agent` 标题和说明
2. 情绪洞察卡：Mood / Energy / music direction
3. MuseCat 卡通角色
4. 对话历史
5. 输入框
6. `Reflect my mood` 按钮
7. 推荐音乐方向卡片，点击后跳到 `Create`

核心路径是：

`输入情绪 → 识别情绪 → Agent 回复 → 推荐 3 个音乐方向 → 点击 Use → 跳到 Create 生成音乐`

**主要问题**
1. 页面标题仍叫 `Music Agent`，但底部 Tab 是 `Mood`，命名不统一。建议页面标题也改成 `Mood` 或 `Muse Mood`。

2. 情绪洞察卡在用户输入前就出现，但默认内容偏功能说明，不够像“当前情绪状态”。建议初始态改成更明确的空状态，例如“Tell MuseCat how you feel”。

3. 对话历史位置太靠前。现在用户还没输入，就先看到历史模块，会打断核心任务。建议顺序改为：角色 → 输入 → 情绪洞察 → 推荐 → 历史。

4. `Reflect my mood` 只“分析”，但用户目标其实是“把情绪变成音乐”。按钮文案建议改成 `Turn mood into music` 或 `Create mood sound`。

5. 推荐卡点击后只是跳到 Create，没有在 Mood 页形成“立即试听/生成”的闭环。建议增加主按钮：`Generate this mood`，直接调用生成。

6. MuseCat 目前是视觉角色，但互动感不足。它会变化表情，但用户不知道为什么变。建议在角色旁显示一句动态短语，例如“Feels tender today”或“I hear calm energy”。

7. 情绪识别规则偏简单。当前主要靠关键词匹配，中文覆盖有限，容易误判。建议增加更多情绪维度：焦虑、孤独、怀念、治愈、兴奋、失眠、专注、释压。

**优先级建议**
P0：统一命名，把 `Music Agent` 改为 `Mood`，按钮改为更明确的音乐结果导向。  
P1：重排页面，把输入框和生成动作提前，让用户更快完成“情绪 → 音乐”。  
P1：推荐卡增加 `Generate`，减少跳转成本。  
P2：增强 MuseCat 的状态反馈，让它像真的在陪伴用户。  
P2：扩展情绪识别词库和标签体系。

**一句话结论**
Mood 页现在像“聊天分析页”，但产品目标应该是“情绪音乐入口”。下一步应把它改成更短路径的：**说出心情 → Agent 理解 → 一键生成/播放对应音乐**。

[545] user: 如何简化mood页面UI


[546] assistant: 可以把 Mood 页简化成一个核心动作：**说出心情，生成/推荐音乐**。

建议改成 4 个区块：

1. **顶部角色区**
   - 只保留 MuseCat + 一句状态文案  
   - 去掉大标题 `Music Agent`
   - 例如：`How are you feeling?`

2. **输入区**
   - 一个大输入框
   - 一个主按钮：`Turn mood into music`
   - 不要把“对话历史”放在输入前

3. **当前情绪卡**
   - 只显示 2 个标签：`Calm`、`Low energy`
   - 下面一句音乐方向：`Soft piano, ambient pads`
   - 去掉复杂说明文字

4. **推荐音乐方向**
   - 最多 3 张小卡
   - 每张只显示：标题、情绪、`Generate`
   - 不再显示长 prompt

可以移除或弱化：
- `Conversation history` 默认折叠
- 长说明文案
- 大量聊天气泡
- `Recommended directions` 大标题
- 过多卡片边框

最简布局：

```text
[MuseCat 表情]
How are you feeling?

[输入心情...]

[Turn mood into music]

Calm · Low energy
Soft piano, ambient pads

[Gentle Reset] [Generate]
[Deep Focus]   [Generate]
[Warm Lift]    [Generate]

History >

@Composable
private fun AgentBubble(message: AgentMessage) {
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = if (message.fromUser) Arrangement.End else Arrangement.Start
    ) {
        Surface(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(if (message.fromUser) 0.82f else 0.9f),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
            color = if (message.fromUser) FlashPlayPalette.Brand else Color.White
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                Text(
                    text = message.text,
                    color = if (message.fromUser) Color.White else FlashPlayPalette.Ink,
                    fontSize = 14.sp,
                    lineHeight = 20.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold
                )
                Text(
                    text = if (message.fromUser) "You" else "MuseCat · ${message.expression}",
                    color = if (message.fromUser) Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.72f) else FlashPlayPalette.Ink.copy(alpha = 0.45f),
                    fontSize = 11.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

[598] assistant: 这是 Mood 页里的 **推荐音乐方向卡片**。

[614] assistant: 检查结果：**app 在播放，Mac 没声音的原因是 Android 模拟器音频桥又卡死了。**

关键状态：

- App 当前确实在 Android 层播放
- 播放器是 ExoPlayer / `AudioTrack`
- `AudioTrack state: started`
- `STREAM_MUSIC` 音量是 `15/15`
- 未静音
- Mac 输出设备是 `Mac mini扬声器`

但模拟器底层日志持续报：

```text
android.hardware.audio@7.1-impl.ranchu: pcm_writei failed
cannot read/write stream data: I/O error
```

这表示：Android 已经把音频写到模拟器音频设备，但模拟器的 `ranchu` 音频层无法继续写到 Mac 宿主机，所以 app 显示播放、进度条也在走，但 Mac 没声音。

结论：**不是 app 播放逻辑问题，也不是音乐文件问题，是当前模拟器音频 HAL/桥接层坏掉了。**

最有效恢复方式：冷重启 Android 模拟器。  
app 侧已经换成 ExoPlayer 并减少切歌时的音频重建，但模拟器本身一旦进入这个 I/O error 状态，通常只能重启模拟器恢复。

class MusicGenerator(private val context: Context) {
    suspend fun generate(

        prompt: String,

        mode: MusicMode

        if (apiKey.isBlank()) {

        }

        val endpoint = BuildConfig.MINIMAX_BASE_URL.trimEnd('/') + BuildConfig.MINIMAX_PATH
        val requestBody = JSONObject().apply {
            put("model", BuildConfig.MINIMAX_MODEL)
            put("prompt", prompt)
            put("is_instrumental", mode.isInstrumental)
            if (!mode.isInstrumental) {
                put("lyrics", lyrics.ifBlank { defaultLyrics(title) })
                put("lyrics_optimizer", false)
            }
            put("output_format", "url")
            put(
                "audio_setting",
                JSONObject().apply {
                    put("sample_rate", 44100)
                    put("bitrate", 256000)
                    put("format", "mp3")
                }
            )
        }

        val connection = (URL(endpoint).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
            requestMethod = "POST"
            connectTimeout = 150_000
            readTimeout = 300_000
            doInput = true
            doOutput = true
            setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json")
            setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer $apiKey")
 <truncated omitted_approx_tokens="509" />eturn "${mode.label} generated and saved locally, $duration."

    private fun defaultLyrics(title: String): String {
        val cleanTitle = title.ifBlank { "This Little Song" }
        return """
            [Verse]
            I wake up with a little light
            Carrying the dream through the morning sky
            Every step becomes a melody
            Every breath is moving next to me

            [Chorus]
            $cleanTitle, let the feeling rise
            Singing out beneath the open skies
            Hold the moment, let it shine along
            Turn my heart into a simple song
        """.trimIndent()
    }

    private fun Double.roundToOne(): String {
        return kotlin.math.round(this * 10.0).div(10.0).toString()
    }

    private fun readText(stream: java.io.InputStream?): String {
        if (stream == null) return ""
        return BufferedReader(stream.reader(Charsets.UTF_8)).use { it.readText() }
    }

    private fun downloadAudio(audioUrl: String): String {
        val musicDir = File(context.filesDir, "generated_music").apply { mkdirs() }
        val output = File(musicDir, "minimax-${System.currentTimeMillis()}.mp3")
        val connection = (URL(audioUrl).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
            requestMethod = "GET"
            connectTimeout = 60_000
            readTimeout = 120_000
            doInput = true
        }
        try {
            val statusCode = connection.responseCode
            if (statusCode !in 200..299) {
                val error = readText(connection.errorStream)
                throw IllegalStateException("Audio download failed ($statusCode): $error")
            }
            connection.inputStream.use { input ->
                output.outputStream().use { fileOut ->
                    input.copyTo(fileOut)
                }
            }
            return output.absolutePath
        } finally {
            connection.disconnect()
        }
    }
}

package com.museplay.android

import android.content.Context
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.File
import java.io.OutputStreamWriter
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URL

class MusicGenerator(private val context: Context) {
    suspend fun generate(
        title: String,
        prompt: String,
        lyrics: String,
        mode: MusicMode
    ): GeneratedMusic = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val apiKey = BuildConfig.MINIMAX_API_KEY.trim()
        if (apiKey.isBlank()) {
            throw IllegalStateException("MINIMAX_API_KEY is missing. Add it to android/secrets.properties.")
        }

        val endpoint = BuildConfig.MINIMAX_BASE_URL.trimEnd('/') + BuildConfig.MINIMAX_PATH
        val requestBody = JSONObject().apply {
            put("model", BuildConfig.MINIMAX_MODEL)
            put("prompt", prompt)
            put("is_instrumental", mode.isInstrumental)
            if (!mode.isInstrumental) {
                put("lyrics", lyrics.ifBlank { defaultLyrics(title) })
                put("lyrics_optimizer", false)
            }
            put("output_format", "url")
            put(
                "audio_setting",
                JSONObject().apply {
                    put("sample_rate", 44100)
                    put("bitrate", 256000)
                    put("format", "mp3")
                }
            )
        }

        val connection = (URL(endpoint).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
            requestMethod = "POST"
            connectTimeout = 150_000
            readTimeout = 300_000
            doInput = true
            doOutput = true
            setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json")
            setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer $apiKey")
 <truncated omitted_approx_tokens="509" />eturn "${mode.label} generated and saved locally, $duration."
    }

    private fun defaultLyrics(title: String): String {
        val cleanTitle = title.ifBlank { "This Little Song" }
        return """
            [Verse]
            I wake up with a little light
            Carrying the dream through the morning sky
            Every step becomes a melody
            Every breath is moving next to me

            [Chorus]
            $cleanTitle, let the feeling rise
            Singing out beneath the open skies
            Hold the moment, let it shine along
            Turn my heart into a simple song
        """.trimIndent()
    }

    private fun Double.roundToOne(): String {
        return kotlin.math.round(this * 10.0).div(10.0).toString()
    }

    private fun readText(stream: java.io.InputStream?): String {
        if (stream == null) return ""
        return BufferedReader(stream.reader(Charsets.UTF_8)).use { it.readText() }
    }

    private fun downloadAudio(audioUrl: String): String {
        val musicDir = File(context.filesDir, "generated_music").apply { mkdirs() }
        val output = File(musicDir, "minimax-${System.currentTimeMillis()}.mp3")
        val connection = (URL(audioUrl).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
            requestMethod = "GET"
            connectTimeout = 60_000
            readTimeout = 120_000
            doInput = true
        }
        try {
            val statusCode = connection.responseCode
            if (statusCode !in 200..299) {
                val error = readText(connection.errorStream)
                throw IllegalStateException("Audio download failed ($statusCode): $error")
            }
            connection.inputStream.use { input ->
                output.outputStream().use { fileOut ->
                    input.copyTo(fileOut)
                }
            }
            return output.absolutePath
        } finally {
            connection.disconnect()
        }
    }
}

class MusicGenerator(private val context: Context) {
    suspend fun generate(

                put("lyrics_optimizer", false)

            put("output_format", "url")
            put(

                    put("sample_rate", 44100)

                    put("format", "mp3")
                }
            )
        }

        val connection = (URL(endpoint).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
            requestMethod = "POST"
            connectTimeout = 150_000

 <truncated omitted_approx_tokens="509" />eturn "${mode.label} generated and saved locally, $duration."

    private fun defaultLyrics(title: String): String {

        return """
            [Verse]
            I wake up with a little light
            Carrying the dream through the morning sky
            Every step becomes a melody
            Every breath is moving next to me

            [Chorus]
            $cleanTitle, let the feeling rise
            Singing out beneath the open skies
            Hold the moment, let it shine along
            Turn my heart into a simple song
        """.trimIndent()
    }

    private fun Double.roundToOne(): String {
        return kotlin.math.round(this * 10.0).div(10.0).toString()
    }

    private fun readText(stream: java.io.InputStream?): String {
        if (stream == null) return ""
        return BufferedReader(stream.reader(Charsets.UTF_8)).use { it.readText() }
    }

    private fun downloadAudio(audioUrl: String): String {
        val musicDir = File(context.filesDir, "generated_music").apply { mkdirs() }
        val output = File(musicDir, "minimax-${System.currentTimeMillis()}.mp3")
        val connection = (URL(audioUrl).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
            requestMethod = "GET"
            connectTimeout = 60_000
            readTimeout = 120_000
            doInput = true
        }
        try {
            val statusCode = connection.responseCode
            if (statusCode !in 200..299) {
                val error = readText(connection.errorStream)
                throw IllegalStateException("Audio download failed ($statusCode): $error")
            }
            connection.inputStream.use { input ->
                output.outputStream().use { fileOut ->
                    input.copyTo(fileOut)
                }
            }
            return output.absolutePath
        } finally {
            connection.disconnect()
        }
    }
}

}

enum class MusicMode(
    val label: String,
    val isInstrumental: Boolean
) {
    Instrumental("Instrumental", true),
    Song("Song", false)
}

enum class PlaybackMode(
    val label: String,
    val icon: String
) {
    Sequential("Sequential", "→"),
    Shuffle("Shuffle", "⤨"),
    RepeatOne("Repeat one", "↻");

    fun next(): PlaybackMode = when (this) {
        Sequential -> Shuffle
        Shuffle -> RepeatOne
        RepeatOne -> Sequential
    }
}

data class MusicPalette(
    val accent: Color,
    val primary: Color,
    val secondary: Color
)

data class MusicTrack(
    val id: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
    val title: String,
    val summary: String,
    val prompt: String,
    val audioUrl: String,
    val localPath: String,
    val durationMs: Long?,
    val mode: MusicMode,
    val palette: MusicPalette,
    val creator: String,
    val isGenerated: Boolean = false,
    val isFavorite: Boolean = false
)

data class GeneratedMusic(
    val title: String,
    val summary: String,
    val prompt: String,
    val audioUrl: String,
    val localPath: String,
    val durationMs: Long?,
    val mode: MusicMode,
    val model: String
)

data class AgentMessage(
    val text: String,
    val fromUser: Boolean,
    val mood: String = "Neutral",
    val expression: String = "calm",
    val createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
)

data class MusicRecommendation(
    val title: String,
    val mood: String,
    val prompt: String
)

data class PromptSeed(
    val title: String,
    val prompt: String,
    val mode: MusicMode = MusicMode.Instrumental
)

data class EmotionInsight(
    val mood: Strin<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="166" />F))
    )
}

object SampleMusic {
    fun feed(): List<MusicTrack> = emptyList()
}

fun MusicTrack.toJson(): org.json.JSONObject = org.json.JSONObject().apply {
    put("id", id)
    put("title", title)
    put("summary", summary)
    put("prompt", prompt)
    put("audioUrl", audioUrl)
    put("localPath", localPath)
    put("durationMs", durationMs ?: org.json.JSONObject.NULL)
    put("mode", mode.name)
    put("creator", creator)
    put("isGenerated", isGenerated)
    put("isFavorite", isFavorite)
}

fun AgentMessage.toJson(): org.json.JSONObject = org.json.JSONObject().apply {
    put("text", text)
    put("fromUser", fromUser)
    put("mood", mood)
    put("expression", expression)
    put("createdAt", createdAt)
}

fun agentMessageFromJson(json: org.json.JSONObject): AgentMessage {
    return AgentMessage(
        text = json.optString("text"),
        fromUser = json.optBoolean("fromUser"),
        mood = json.optString("mood", "Neutral"),
        expression = json.optString("expression", "calm"),
        createdAt = json.optLong("createdAt", System.currentTimeMillis())
    )
}

fun musicTrackFromJson(json: org.json.JSONObject, palette: MusicPalette): MusicTrack {
    return MusicTrack(
        id = json.optString("id").ifBlank { UUID.randomUUID().toString() },
        title = json.optString("title", "Generated Track"),
        summary = json.optString("summary", "Generated and saved locally."),
        prompt = json.optString("prompt"),
        audioUrl = json.optString("audioUrl"),
        localPath = json.optString("localPath"),
        durationMs = json.optLong("durationMs").takeIf { !json.isNull("durationMs") && it > 0 },
        mode = runCatching { MusicMode.valueOf(json.optString("mode")) }.getOrDefault(MusicMode.Instrumental),
        palette = palette,
        creator = json.optString("creator", "Local"),
        isGenerated = json.optBoolean("isGenerated", true),
        isFavorite = json.optBoolean("isFavorite", false)
    )
}

import fs from "node:fs";

const rootDir = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..");

const totalSongs = Number.parseInt(process.argv[2] || "20", 10);
const totalInstrumentals = Number.parseInt(process.argv[3] || "20", 10);
const endpoint = "https://api.minimax.io/v1/music_generation";
const model = "music-2.6";

function readProperties(filePath) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return {};
  return Object.fromEntries(
    fs
      .readFileSync(filePath, "utf8")
      .split(/\r?\n/)
      .map((line) => line.trim())
      .filter((line) => line && !line.startsWith("#") && line.includes("="))
      .map((line) => {
        const index = line.indexOf("=");
        return [line.slice(0, index).trim(), line.slice(index + 1).trim()];
      }),
  );
}

function apiKey() {
  const envKey = process.env.MINIMAX_API_KEY?.trim();
  if (envKey) return envKey;
  const localEnv = readProperties(path.join(rootDir, ".env.local")).MINIMAX_API_KEY;
  if (localEnv) return localEnv;
  const secrets = readProperties(path.join(rootDir, "android/secrets.properties")).MINIMAX_API_KEY;
  if (secrets) return secrets;
  throw new Error("MINIMAX_API_KEY is missing.");
}

function slug(value) {
  return value
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "")
    .slice(0, 64);
}

function batchFileName(item, mode, index) {
  const prefix = mode === "Song" ? "song" : "instrumental";
  return `batch-${prefix}-${String(index).padStart(2, "0")}-${slug(item.title)}.mp3`;
}

function defaultLyrics(title) {
  return `[Verse]

Every step finds a brighter beat
If the night gets heavy on my mind
I leave a little silver line

[Chorus]
${title}, lift me into light
Turn the dark into something bright
Hold the moment, make it strong
Let my heart become the song`;
}

  if (!fs.existsSync(manifestPath)) return [];
  return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(manifestPath, "utf8"));
}

function writeManifest(entries) {

class MusicGenerator(private val context: Context) {
    suspend fun generate(

                put("lyrics_optimizer", false)

            put("output_format", "url")
            put(

                    put("sample_rate", 44100)

                    put("format", "mp3")
                }
            )
        }

        val connection = (URL(endpoint).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
            requestMethod = "POST"
            connectTimeout = 150_000

 <truncated omitted_approx_tokens="509" />eturn "${mode.label} generated and saved locally, $duration."

    private fun defaultLyrics(title: String): String {

        return """
            [Verse]
            I wake up with a little light
            Carrying the dream through the morning sky
            Every step becomes a melody
            Every breath is moving next to me

            [Chorus]
            $cleanTitle, let the feeling rise
            Singing out beneath the open skies
            Hold the moment, let it shine along
            Turn my heart into a simple song
        """.trimIndent()
    }

    private fun Double.roundToOne(): String {
        return kotlin.math.round(this * 10.0).div(10.0).toString()
    }

    private fun readText(stream: java.io.InputStream?): String {
        if (stream == null) return ""
        return BufferedReader(stream.reader(Charsets.UTF_8)).use { it.readText() }
    }

    private fun downloadAudio(audioUrl: String): String {
        val musicDir = File(context.filesDir, "generated_music").apply { mkdirs() }
        val output = File(musicDir, "minimax-${System.currentTimeMillis()}.mp3")
        val connection = (URL(audioUrl).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
            requestMethod = "GET"
            connectTimeout = 60_000
            readTimeout = 120_000
            doInput = true
        }
        try {
            val statusCode = connection.responseCode
            if (statusCode !in 200..299) {
                val error = readText(connection.errorStream)
                throw IllegalStateException("Audio download failed ($statusCode): $error")
            }
            connection.inputStream.use { input ->
                output.outputStream().use { fileOut ->
                    input.copyTo(fileOut)
                }
            }
            return output.absolutePath
        } finally {
            connection.disconnect()
        }
    }
}

    Agent("Mood"),
    Me("Library")
}

enum class MusicMode(
    val label: String,
    val isInstrumental: Boolean
) {
    Instrumental("Instrumental", true),
    Song("Song", false)
}

enum class PlaybackMode(
    val label: String,
    val icon: String
) {
    Sequential("Sequential", "→"),
    Shuffle("Shuffle", "⤨"),
    RepeatOne("Repeat one", "↻");

    fun next(): PlaybackMode = when (this) {
        Sequential -> Shuffle
        Shuffle -> RepeatOne
        RepeatOne -> Sequential
    }
}

data class MusicPalette(
    val accent: Color,
    val primary: Color,
    val secondary: Color
)

data class MusicTrack(
    val id: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
    val title: String,
    val summary: String,
    val prompt: String,
    val audioUrl: String,
    val localPath: String,
    val durationMs: Long?,
    val mode: MusicMode,
    val palette: MusicPalette,
    val creator: String,
    val isGenerated: Boolean = false,
    val isFavorite: Boolean = false
)

data class GeneratedMusic(
    val title: String,

    val prompt: String,
    val audioUrl: String,
    val localPath: String,
    val durationMs: Long?,
    val mode: MusicMode,

)

data class AgentMessage(
    val text: String,
    val fromUser: Boolean,
    val mood: String = "Neutral",
    val expression: String = "calm",
    val createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
)

data class MusicRecommendation(
    val title: String,
    val mood: String,
    val prompt: String
)

data class PromptSeed(
    val title: String,
    val prompt: String,
    val mode: MusicMode = MusicMode.Instrumental
)

data class EmotionInsight(
    val mood: Strin<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="166" />F))
    )
}

object SampleMusic {
    fun feed(): List<MusicTrack> = emptyList()
}

fun MusicTrack.toJson(): org.json.JSONObject = org.json.JSONObject().apply {
    put("id", id)
    put("title", title)
    put("summary", summary)
    put("prompt", prompt)
    put("audioUrl", audioUrl)
    put("localPath", localPath)
    put("durationMs", durationMs ?: org.json.JSONObject.NULL)
    put("mode", mode.name)
    put("creator", creator)
    put("isGenerated", isGenerated)
    put("isFavorite", isFavorite)
}

fun AgentMessage.toJson(): org.json.JSONObject = org.json.JSONObject().apply {
    put("text", text)
    put("fromUser", fromUser)
    put("mood", mood)
    put("expression", expression)
    put("createdAt", createdAt)
}

fun agentMessageFromJson(json: org.json.JSONObject): AgentMessage {
    return AgentMessage(
        text = json.optString("text"),
        fromUser = json.optBoolean("fromUser"),
        mood = json.optString("mood", "Neutral"),
        expression = json.optString("expression", "calm"),
        createdAt = json.optLong("createdAt", System.currentTimeMillis())
    )
}

fun musicTrackFromJson(json: org.json.JSONObject, palette: MusicPalette): MusicTrack {
    return MusicTrack(
        id = json.optString("id").ifBlank { UUID.randomUUID().toString() },
        title = json.optString("title", "Generated Track"),
        summary = json.optString("summary", "Generated and saved locally."),
        prompt = json.optString("prompt"),
        audioUrl = json.optString("audioUrl"),
        localPath = json.optString("localPath"),
        durationMs = json.optLong("durationMs").takeIf { !json.isNull("durationMs") && it > 0 },
        mode = runCatching { MusicMode.valueOf(json.optString("mode")) }.getOrDefault(MusicMode.Instrumental),
        palette = palette,
        creator = json.optString("creator", "Local"),
        isGenerated = json.optBoolean("isGenerated", true),
        isFavorite = json.optBoolean("isFavorite", false)
    )
}
